articles.title: CodeQuant2: Enhanced Outlier Mitigation and Adaptive Clustering for Low-Precision LRMs
articles.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve task performance by generating longer intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs and makes low-precision quantization increasingly important. However, aggressively quantized models often perform poorly on reasoning tasks. We observe larger activation fluctuations during the first decoding steps of reasoning. Calibration that omits these early states may miss their activation fluctuations. To address these reasoning-specific quantization challenges, we propose \textbf{CodeQuant2}, a clustering-based LUT quantization framework for low-precision large reasoning models. CodeQuant2 mitigates activation outliers with rotation and scaling, uses clustering to represent non-uniform weight distributions, and adapts codebook sizes to the quantization difficulty of each layer. Guided by our observation of reasoning-time activation behavior, CodeQuant2 further improves calibration sample selection to better match actual decoding statistics. Combined with our customized LUT CUDA kernel, CodeQuant2 delivers substantial accuracy improvements on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to $2.85\times$ speedup over BF16.
articles.titleCn: CodeQuant2：增强异常值缓解和自适应聚类用于低精度LRMs
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过生成更长的中间推理轨迹来提升任务性能，但这会显著增加推理成本，并使得低精度量化变得日益重要。然而，激进量化的模型在推理任务上的表现往往不佳。我们观察到在推理的初始解码步骤中存在更大的激活波动。忽略这些早期状态的校准可能会错过它们的激活波动。为解决推理特有的量化挑战，我们提出了\textbf{CodeQuant2}，一种基于聚类的LUT量化框架，用于低精度大型推理模型。CodeQuant2通过旋转和缩放来缓解激活异常值，利用聚类来表示非均匀的权重分布，并根据每一层的量化难度调整码本大小。基于我们对推理时激活行为的观察，CodeQuant2进一步改进了校准样本的选择，以更好地匹配实际的解码统计信息。结合我们定制的LUT CUDA内核，CodeQuant2在推理基准测试中实现了显著的精度提升，同时相较于BF16实现了高达2.85倍的加速。

articles.title: How far does a hash-only sender go? A pre-registered map of sender memory versus bits for short text messages
articles.abstract: Can a sender that only computes hashes, with a language model only at the receiver, transmit short human text more cheaply than a classical sender trained on the same domain? We answer with one pre-registered run on 1,000 English user utterances from Taskmaster-1. The primary endpoint is the cost per message to deliver 100% of the messages (hash bits, plus a 2-byte negative acknowledgement and the raw text when the first attempt fails), paired against an in-domain PPM order-1 sender. The hash-only sender delivered 857 of 1,000 messages on the first attempt and cost 192.8 bits per message, 18.4 bits more than PPM order 1 (95% bootstrap interval 10.9 to 26.3); by the pre-registered rule it spends more and is not equivalent within one byte. As secondary results we map measured sender memory against bits. The hash-only sender (8,190 B on a host build, keyed BLAKE2b tag included, as in every method) was the cheapest point in bits from 8,190 B up to, but excluding, PPM order 1 at 24,844 B, 45 to 46 bits below smaz2 and Unishox2; from PPM order 1 upwards, in-domain senders spend fewer bits, except order 2 pruned to 16 KiB. In airtime it loses to PPM order 1 on all five links priced, to Unishox2 on four, and to raw text with a tag on two, because each failure costs an acknowledgement frame and a fallback frame. A wider receiver search recovers half of the failures and makes the cost 7.7 bits lower than PPM order 1, at about three minutes of receiver time per failure, and still loses in airtime on four of five links. We report the measurement as a delimitation, with every deviation of the run.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code, data and per-message results: https://github.com/msamoilenko/hash-sender-llm-receiver
articles.titleCn: 一个仅使用哈希的发送者能走多远？一个预先注册的发送者内存与短文本消息位数映射表
articles.abstractCn: 一个仅计算哈希值的发送者，在接收端配备语言模型，能否比在相同领域经过训练的经典发送者更经济地传输短人类文本？我们通过在Taskmaster-1的1000个英语用户语句上的一次预先注册运行来回答这个问题。主要指标是每条消息的成本，以传输100%的消息（哈希位，加上2字节的否定确认，并在第一次尝试失败时传输原始文本），与领域内PPM顺序1发送者进行对比。仅哈希发送者在第一次尝试中成功传输了1000条消息中的857条，每条消息成本为192.8位，比PPM顺序1多18.4位（95%引导区间为10.9至26.3）；根据预先注册的规则，它花费更多，且在一个字节内不等价。作为次要结果，我们将测量的发送者内存与比特数进行映射。仅哈希发送者（在主机构建上为8190字节，包含密钥BLAKE2b标签，如所有方法中所述）在8190字节至（但不包括）PPM顺序1的24844字节范围内是比特成本最低的点，比smaz2和Unishox2低45至46位；从PPM顺序1开始，领域内发送者使用的比特数更少，除了被剪枝到16KiB的顺序2。在传输时间上，它在所有五个定价链路上输给PPM顺序1，在四个链路上输给Unishox2，在两个链路上输给带有标签的原始文本，因为每次失败都需一个确认帧和一个回退帧。更广泛的接收器搜索可恢复一半的失败，并将成本降低7.7位，达到每次失败约三分钟的接收器时间，但在五个链路中的四个上仍然在传输时间上处于劣势。我们报告这一测量结果作为界定，包含运行中的所有偏差。

articles.title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
articles.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0$\times$ higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4.
articles.titleCn: BitDecoding-FP4：基于算法-系统协同设计的原生FP4 KV缓存解码
articles.abstractCn: 键值（KV）缓存主导了长上下文大语言模型服务的内存容量和带宽。虽然4位微缩放格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）缩小了缓存并在FP4张量核心上运行注意力机制，但算法量化与系统感知加速之间仍存在一个基本差距：现有的FP4 KV系统使用普通的量化方法导致严重精度下降，而以精度为导向的4位算法则依赖于矢量码本，其查找开销降低了解码吞吐量。我们提出了BitDecoding-FP4，这是一种用于精确高效原生FP4 KV解码的算法-系统协同设计。我们缓解了三种误差来源：双残差查询量化将查询分成两个FP4张量，将查询逻辑误差从60%降至1%；溢出感知概率缩放防止E4M3缩放将长上下文概率舍入为零；异常值感知键量化结合静态平滑、哈达玛旋转和缩放搜索，在分词级缩放下抑制键异常值。在系统层面，我们通过转置softmax结合概率量化融合和分页KV缓存上的堆叠查询MMA来移除softmax瓶颈。在GQA和MLA的密集和MoE模型中，BitDecoding-FP4在NVFP4上保持在BF16 KV精度0.5以内（MXFP4上为1），并在RL训练轮次中跟踪BF16 KV。在NVIDIA B300上的端到端服务中，使用Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-30B-A3B，它比BF16 KV的峰值服务吞吐量高出2.4-3.0倍。实现代码可在https://github.com/OpenBitSys/BitDecoding-FP4获取。

articles.title: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
articles.abstract: A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar's exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree. On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6. That loss has a structure. Our lead falls as the reference answer demands more source wording, 9.6 points ahead at one or two reference words and 3.1 behind past eight, with token overlap moving the same way, so the judge is not the cause. Compaction keeps what a fact asserts and discards how it was said, so it wins where the answer is a value and loses where it is a phrasing. We also report four negative results with their power calculations.
articles.comment: 7 figures. Data and code: https://github.com/BigBrown10/nmafc-paper
articles.titleCn: 在双层对话记忆中的压实、衰减和强化：与检索增强生成的配对评估
articles.abstractCn: 一个需要记忆的对话代理必须决定保留什么内容。检索增强生成会保留对话记录并进行搜索；另一种方法是压缩每一轮对话为原子事实并进行搜索。我们在LoCoMo上比较了这两种方法，两种方法都在一个窗口中回答所有1,985个问题，针对相同的存储库，使用相同的生成器和评判者，并在同一行中显示两种预测结果，这允许我们在512个存在分歧的问题上使用McNemar精确检验。在四个可比较的工作报告类别中，压缩得分71.4%，而检索增强生成仅为64.6%，领先6.8个百分点（p = 5.5e-08），且提示词数量减少了34%。在所有五个类别中，包括对抗性集，可比较工作的得分下降，领先优势降至2.0，不再具有统计学意义，因为基线方法在对抗性集上领先14.6%。这种损失具有结构。当参考答案需要更多源文本时，我们的领先优势会下降，在参考答案包含一个或两个参考词时领先9.6个百分点，而在参考答案包含超过八个词时落后3.1个百分点，词重叠趋势相同，因此评判者并非原因。压缩保留了事实所断言的内容，而丢弃了其表达方式，因此当答案为值时它会获胜，而当答案为措辞时它会失败。我们还报告了四种负面结果及其效力计算。

articles.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model
articles.abstract: Laya answers typed multiple-choice questions in one forward pass by scoring a hidden state at one [MASK] marker per option. We re-engineer the checkpoint (421M parameters; a 2-layer option head with no positional tensor; a documented but unused parallel layout) and test whether the answer depends on where an option is listed. Presenting 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options (or six random permutations for 12 options), the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% [22.9-28.7] of questions (19.7% on the 605 English-language items alone); accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and the flips concentrate where the model's own confidence is low (54% versus 8% across confidence terciles). Fine-tuning with Laya's trainer on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%; the identical rows without shuffling give 11.4%, so shuffling is responsible for 4.2 points of the improvement. A confidence-weighted vote over orderings gives 69.7% against 69.1% for a single base pass at 4.1x the compute. Labels are LLM-made and the test sets are teacher-filtered. We also fine-tune with the authors' parallel layout on the same rows: flip rate 0.5%.
articles.comment: 24 pages, 13 figures, 23 tables
articles.titleCn: Maya a1：选项是读取模型还是其位置？非自回归决策模型中的顺序敏感性
articles.abstractCn: Laya通过在每个选项的标记处为隐藏状态打分，在一个前向传递中回答打字选择题。我们重新设计了检查点（4210万参数；一个无位置张量的两层选项头；一个记录在案但未使用的并行布局），并测试答案是否取决于选项的排列位置。在选项的每个循环旋转下（或12个选项的六个随机排列）呈现951个Qwen验证的问题，发布的检查点有25.8%[22.9-28.7]的问题改变了答案（仅605个英文项目为19.7%）；以正确选项在前与在后相比，准确率相差10.1分，而翻转集中在模型自身置信度较低的地方（置信度三分位中，54%与8%）。使用Laya的trainer在2818行教师验证数据上微调，选项打乱后翻转率降至7.2%；未打乱的相同行给出11.4%，因此打乱负责了4.2分的改进。置信度加权的投票在排序上给出69.7%，而单次基础传递为69.1%，计算量增加4.1倍。标签由LLM生成，测试集由教师筛选。我们还使用作者的并行布局在同一行上微调：翻转率0.5%。

articles.title: Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLMs Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation
articles.abstract: External lexical resources can help large language models (LLMs) translate texts in low-resource languages and specialized domains, but these resources may conflict with models' prior lexical knowledge. To isolate this conflict, we construct a controlled Mandarin-to-English translation task in which familiar source words are assigned new meanings within and across semantic categories. We treat these prompt-supplied meanings as contextual knowledge (CK) and systematically evaluate the effects of word frequency, sentence context, and prompt framing on the translated outputs. Across nine models, CK reliance is greater for less frequent source words and in sentence contexts that support the supplied meanings. Prompt framing can reduce CK reliance, but seven of nine models favor CK even when explicitly instructed to ignore the supplied meanings. Within model families, larger models are more likely than smaller models to utilize CK in their outputs. Three follow-up experiments further show that modal weakening lowers CK reliance, the effect of repetition depends on prompt layout, and the effect of reasoning varies across models. Overall, our controlled study reveals how CK reliance varies across conditions and models, motivating new methods to detect and evaluate lexical conflicts and guide models' lexical choices in LLM-based translation.
articles.titleCn: 这些程序员熟透到可以吃了吗？评估大型语言模型如何处理翻译中的词汇知识冲突
articles.abstractCn: 外部词汇资源可以帮助大型语言模型（LLMs）翻译低资源语言和专业领域的文本，但这些资源可能与模型的先验词汇知识产生冲突。为了隔离这种冲突，我们构建了一个受控的中文到英文翻译任务，其中熟悉的源词在语义类别内部和跨类别被赋予新的含义。我们将这些提示提供的含义视为情境知识（CK），并系统地评估了词频、句子上下文和提示框架对翻译输出的影响。在九个模型中，低频源词和句子上下文支持提供的含义时，CK依赖性更强。提示框架可以减少CK依赖性，但九个模型中的七个即使在明确指示忽略提供的含义时，仍倾向于使用CK。在模型家族内部，大型模型比小型模型更有可能在输出中利用CK。三个后续实验进一步表明，情态弱化会降低CK依赖性，重复的影响取决于提示布局，推理的影响因模型而异。总体而言，我们的受控研究揭示了CK依赖性在不同条件和模型中的变化，为检测和评估词汇冲突以及指导基于LLM的翻译中的模型词汇选择提供了新的方法。

articles.title: ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) require continuous factual updates to stay current, yet lifelong knowledge editing remains a daunting challenge. The primary obstacle is the severe Locality Erosion and Catastrophic Forgetting, where sequential edits inevitably interfere with pre-trained capabilities and prior updates. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ROSE}, a \textbf{R}isk-aware \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{S}ubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbf{E}diting. ROSE addresses forgetting by aiming to restrict parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces. Crucially, it introduces a risk-guided mechanism that utilizes a dynamically computed risk mask to safeguard specific factual parameter subspaces essential for model stability. During inference, ROSE employs a multi-granularity knowledge integration strategy, featuring prototype-anchored semantic gating and perturbation-driven subspace fusion to precisely activate edited knowledge for relevant queries while limiting interference on unrelated inputs. Comprehensive experiments on two prominent multimodal benchmarks show that ROSE is competitive with state-of-the-art approaches across five key metrics, while maintaining outstanding stability over $1,000$ sequential updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunlitsong/ROSE.
articles.titleCn: ROSE：面向多模态大语言模型终身知识编辑的风险感知正交子空间导航
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）需要持续的事实更新以保持时效性，然而终身知识编辑仍然是一个巨大的挑战。主要障碍是严重的局部侵蚀和灾难性遗忘，其中顺序编辑不可避免地会干扰预训练能力并影响先前更新。在本文中，我们提出了 \textbf{ROSE}，一个 \textbf{R}isk-aware \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{S}ubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbf{E}diting。ROSE通过旨在将参数更新限制在先前编辑子空间的正交补空间中来解决遗忘问题。关键地，它引入了一种风险引导机制，该机制利用动态计算的风险掩码来保护对模型稳定性至关重要的特定事实参数子空间。在推理过程中，ROSE采用多粒度知识融合策略，具有原型锚定语义门控和扰动驱动的子空间融合，以精确地激活编辑后的知识以响应相关查询，同时限制对无关输入的干扰。在两个著名的多模态基准测试上的全面实验表明，ROSE在五个关键指标上与最先进的方法具有竞争力，同时在 $1,000$ 次顺序更新中保持了出色的稳定性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/sunlitsong/ROSE 获取。

articles.title: Language as Trait, Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance's speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker's messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players' votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.
articles.titleCn: 语言作为特征，礼貌作为策略：对大型语言模型社交推理代理中语言效应的受控测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理通过对话进行协调，相同的信息可以用更简单或更复杂的语言、直白或礼貌的方式表达。我们通过LURK狼人杀框架进行测试，该框架将每个话语的言语行为谓词与其自然语言实现分离，以检验这些差异是否改变其他代理的判断和行动方式。我们仅重写实现部分，确保游戏内容得以保留，并从保存的检查点重新播放每个游戏日，与重新采样的对照组进行对比。我们始终如一地调整每个说话者在每条消息中的语言范围和礼貌策略。在30场游戏和4,335次重播中，任何操纵都不会改变其他代理对说话者的信任，且在多重比较校正后，投票或夜间行动没有显著影响；未经校正的最大效应是，将语言范围从中性释义移开会改变其他玩家约4个百分点的投票。在自然游戏中，88%的威胁面子的言语行为无论角色如何，都是直白且公开的。

articles.title: MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
articles.abstract: LLM agents benefit from using memory systems to improve performance on long-horizon, multi-session tasks. However, memory introduces a critical attack surface. Malicious instructions encountered in one session may be stored and propagated through memory before being retrieved and acted upon in later sessions. Because memory systems differ in how they process and retrieve information, the downstream effects of poisoning can vary significantly across systems. To quantify the effects of poisoning across different memory architectures, we introduce MemoryDojo, a benchmark for tracing the lifecycle of poisoned information through agent memory and measuring its influence on subsequent agent behavior. MemoryDojo is easily extensible, consists of 155 multi-session long-horizon trajectories covering four domains, and supports five different memory systems. Through our evaluation, we find that all memory systems are susceptible to memory poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects. We further propose a memory-aware poison optimization process that increases the poisoning efficacy, highlighting differences between memory architectures. We hope that MemoryDojo will support research on understanding and mitigating agentic memory risks.
articles.titleCn: 记忆道场：通过大型语言模型代理内存进行中毒测试
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理通过使用记忆系统来提升在长时程、多会话任务上的表现，但记忆也引入了一个关键的安全漏洞。在一个会话中遇到的恶意指令可能会被存储并通过记忆系统传播，然后在后续会话中被检索并执行。由于记忆系统在处理和检索信息的方式上存在差异，中毒行为对下游系统的影响可能差异显著。为了量化不同记忆架构中毒害效果，我们引入了MemoryDojo，这是一个用于追踪中毒信息在代理记忆中的生命周期并衡量其对后续代理行为影响的基准测试。MemoryDojo易于扩展，包含155条涵盖四个领域的多会话长时程轨迹，并支持五种不同的记忆系统。通过我们的评估，我们发现所有记忆系统都易受记忆中毒攻击，且下游影响存在显著差异。我们进一步提出了一种记忆感知中毒优化过程，该过程提升了中毒效能，并突出了不同记忆架构之间的差异。我们希望MemoryDojo能够支持对理解和缓解代理记忆风险的研究。

articles.title: RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill
articles.abstract: RidgeFill shortens prefill by not computing most of a model's upper layers for the prompt. The lower layers run exactly up to a split; from the split layer's state a per-layer map predicts every later layer's input, and each late layer writes its cache from that prediction. The design follows YOCO and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, where the projection is trained into the model. RidgeFill retrofits it onto models that were never trained for it: the map is a ridge regression fitted once in closed form from one pass over calibration text, the layer's own projections run unchanged, and a chosen set of rows, the last few thousand tokens, and every decoding step run the full model. Nothing is trained and no token is dropped. Most of the work was in measurement, finding a repeatable methodology. Loss averaged over all tokens hides RidgeFill's error. Needle retrieval in the filled region, loss on tokens that depend on distant context, and splice tests that swap filled keys or values for exact ones show which component carries it: the keys on Llama-3.1-8B, half of it in their scale, and the values and the recurrent state on Qwen3.5-9B. On Qwen3.8-27B in a llama.cpp fork on an A100, time to first token is 1.25 to 1.31x faster at 16K to 120K tokens with the maps in VRAM; RULER changes by -1.2 and -1.4 points and LongBench v2 by -1.4; the 95 % intervals include zero but do not rule out losses of a few points. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in vLLM it is 1.50 to 1.60x faster than exact at 9K to 32K tokens, with RULER's needle tasks at 99.8 against 100.0 and perplexity on novel tokens 2.65 % higher [-0.02 %, +4.93 %]. On three 8 to 9B reference models, at the same split and tail as the identity fill, the fitted map retrieves 49.1 and 49.6 more filled-region RULER points on the two dense models (at that split Llama's loss is worse), and its long-document loss is +/-0.03 nats of the released SwiftKV checkpoint's.
articles.comment: 50 pages, 15 figures, 38 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Approximate-Science/ridgefill-data
articles.titleCn: RidgeFill：无训练的晚层缓存填充，用于更快的预填充
articles.abstractCn: RidgeFill通过不计算提示所需模型的大部分上层来缩短预填充时间。较低层精确运行到分割层；从分割层状态开始，每层映射预测后续每一层的输入，并且每一层从该预测中写入其缓存。该设计遵循YOCO和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，其中投影被训练到模型中。RidgeFill将其适配到从未为此训练过的模型：映射是一次以闭式形式从一次校准文本遍历中拟合的岭回归，层的自身投影保持不变，并且选择的一组行、最后几千个标记以及每个解码步骤运行完整模型。没有东西被训练，也没有标记被丢弃。大部分工作在于测量，找到一个可重复的方法。所有标记上的平均损失掩盖了RidgeFill的错误。填充区域内的针检索、依赖于远距离上下文的标记上的损失以及交换填充键或值以获取精确值的拼接测试显示了哪个组件承载了错误：Llama-3.1-8B上的键，其中一半在其尺度内，以及Qwen3.5-9B上的值和循环状态。在A100上的llama.cpp分支中，对于Qwen3.8-27B，在16K到120K标记时，带有映射的VRAM中，第一个标记的时间是1.25到1.31倍更快；RULER变化为-1.2和-1.4分，LongBench v2变化为-1.4；95%区间包括零，但排除了几分的损失。在vLLM中的Qwen3.8-Flash-Next中，在9K到32K标记时，比精确值快1.50到1.60倍，RULER的针任务为99.8对100.0，新标记的困惑度高出2.65%（[-0.02%，+4.93%]）。在三个8到9B参考模型上，与身份填充相同的分割和尾部，拟合的映射在两个密集模型上检索到填充区域RULER点多49.1和49.6（在该分割处Llama的损失更差），其长文档损失与发布的SwiftKV检查点的±0.03纳特相同。

articles.title: How Much Conversation History Does an AI Agent Need?
articles.abstract: How does using less conversational history change reader-token use and benchmark scores? We examine this question on 1,100 BEAM questions. We held the retrieval ranking and reader constant across five fixed passage budgets, and mean assigned scores rose as the passage budget grew. The score gain per additional token became smaller at the upper tested budgets. Answerable questions generally received higher scores with more context. Pooled abstention scores sometimes rose as the passage budget shrank. We also tested message retention in a controlled task with explicit conversational-state targets and compared retained user messages with token-matched recency. Qwen matched the full state more often for direct requirements when user messages were retained. Its full-state matching declined when answers depended on references to earlier offers. Mistral produced near-floor results across the retention conditions. A scoring audit leaves the correctness of BEAM answers unresolved. These experiments characterize the token and score consequences of the tested memory budgets. Reliable budget selection depends on retaining the evidence each question requires and validating the measure used to assess answer quality.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures
articles.titleCn: 一个AI代理需要多少对话历史？
articles.abstractCn: 使用较少的对话历史如何改变读者-标记使用和基准分数？我们针对这一问题在1,100个BEAM问题上进行了研究。我们保持检索排名和读者不变，跨越五个固定的段落预算，平均分配的分数随着段落预算的增长而上升。在较高的测试预算下，每增加一个标记的分数提升变得较小。可回答的问题通常在提供更多上下文时获得更高的分数。当段落预算缩小时，池化回避分数有时会上升。我们还在一个具有明确对话状态目标的受控任务中测试了消息保留情况，并将保留的用户消息与标记匹配的时效性进行了比较。当用户消息被保留时，Qwen更频繁地匹配完整状态以应对直接要求。当答案依赖于对早期提议的引用时，其完整状态匹配率下降。Mistral在所有保留条件下都产生了接近底线的成绩。评分审核并未解决BEAM答案的正确性。这些实验描述了测试记忆预算的标记和分数后果。可靠的预算选择取决于保留每个问题所需证据，并验证用于评估答案质量的度量标准。

articles.title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
articles.abstract: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. We also evaluate the two largest models on rewriting comments to preserve wording while reducing clues about personal attributes. On the first two tasks, LambdaMix achieves higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy merging baselines across all four models. LambdaMix uses fewer training completions and stores fewer adapter parameters than a set of GRPO specialist policies. With architecture and initialization fixed, varying adapter mixtures and objective weights together gives wider score ranges and higher coverage than varying either alone.
articles.comment: Preprint. Under review
articles.titleCn: 可调多目标组相对偏好优化与联合训练的低秩适配器
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型部署往往需要在不断变化的用户偏好下，在相互竞争的目标之间进行权衡，而标准的训练后方法通常为固定的目标权重生成单一策略。我们引入了LambdaMix，这是一种新的参数高效方法，通过组相对在线强化学习学习条件化策略家族。LambdaMix联合训练每个目标对应的一个低秩适配器，在冻结的基础模型上。一个偏好向量选择生成响应的适配器混合，并加权分别归一化的奖励来更新适配器。单次训练运行支持推理时偏好变化，无需进一步优化。我们在有益性、无害性以及遵循指令解决数学问题四个模型上进行了实验。我们还评估了两个最大模型在重写评论以保留措辞同时减少个人属性线索方面的表现。在前两个任务中，LambdaMix在所有四个模型上均比所有评估的条件化策略合并基线实现了更高的超体积。LambdaMix使用的训练完成次数更少，存储的适配器参数也更少，优于一组GRPO专家策略。在架构和初始化固定的情况下，同时变化适配器混合和目标权重，比单独变化任何一项，能获得更宽的分数范围和更高的覆盖率。

articles.title: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
articles.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent's weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT.
articles.comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT
articles.titleCn: RuACT：恢复非活动评分标准作为自适应的批评者和教师
articles.abstractCn: 基于评分标准的强化学习（RL）通过将每个响应与特定查询的评分标准进行评分，为开放式任务扩展了具有可验证奖励的强化学习。然而，在群体相对优化下，每个采样响应都失败（不可达）或通过（饱和）的评分标准会使所有响应得到相同的结果，没有学习信号；在Qwen3-4B医学训练中，60.88%的查询-评分标准观察结果是无效的。我们发现这两种状态缺乏不同的监督：在提示中声明不可达的评分标准将其满意度从1.13%提高到91.25%，而所有通过饱和评分标准的响应仍然存在质量差异。因此，我们提出了RuACT（评分标准作为自适应的批评者和教师），它为每个无效评分标准分配一个提供其缺失内容的角色。评分标准作为教师将不可达的评分标准用作奖励门控的在线策略自蒸馏的特权信息，评分标准作为批评家将饱和评分标准分解为子评分标准，这些子评分标准分离当前响应，同时共享父级的权重。RuACT在所有四个医学和科学基准上使用Qwen3-4B均优于GRPO、评分标准重新加权以及评分标准引导的探索，并使用Qwen3-1.7B实现了最佳平均性能。在最初不可达的评分标准上，无引导恢复率从35.02%提高到42.86%，而子级优化提高了独立运行中的奖励-质量一致性，从57.74%提高到60.77%。代码可在https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT获取。

articles.title: Query-Guided RoPE Modulation for Lost-in-the-Middle Mitigation in Long-Context LLMs
articles.abstract: Long-context language models often neglect information in the middle of the input, a phenomenon known as "lost-in-the-middle". Part of this gap may stem from the long-range decay of rotary position embedding (RoPE), which weakens the positional signal between distant tokens. Existing input compression deletes low-importance tokens, and attention reweighting acts only after RoPE has weakened this signal. RoPE-level methods modify positions directly but apply the same remapping to every query. To address these limitations, we propose QGPM (Query-Guided Positional Modulation), a training-free method that reshapes RoPE positions using query relevance from the model's own attention heads. QGPM builds a broad relevance map for lower layers and a sharp one for upper layers. Low-relevance tokens advance by less than one position on fast-rotating planes, pulling relevant evidence toward the query. Slow-rotating planes keep the original layout, with every token in place. Experiments on NoLiMa and RULER with multiple context lengths show that QGPM improves over base models and strong baselines, with the largest gains on retrieval tasks, and generalizes across multiple backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/iZHpy/QGPM.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/iZHpy/QGPM
articles.titleCn: 基于查询的RoPE调制用于长上下文LLM中的中间丢失缓解
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文语言模型常常忽略输入中间部分的信息，这种现象被称为“中间丢失”。部分这种差距可能源于旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的长程衰减，它削弱了远距离标记之间的位置信号。现有的输入压缩方法会删除低重要性标记，而注意力重加权方法则是在RoPE削弱该信号之后才起作用。RoPE级别的改进方法直接修改位置，但它们对每个查询都应用相同的重映射。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了QGPM（查询引导的位置调制），这是一种无需训练的方法，它利用模型自身注意力头的查询相关性来重塑RoPE位置。QGPM为低层构建一个广泛的关联图，为高层构建一个尖锐的关联图。低相关性标记在快速旋转平面上前进的位置不足一个，将相关证据拉向查询。慢速旋转平面保持原始布局，每个标记都保持在原位。在NoLiMa和RULER上的多项实验表明，对于多种上下文长度，QGPM优于基础模型和强基线，在检索任务上取得了最大提升，并且能够泛化到多个主干网络。我们的代码可在https://github.com/iZHpy/QGPM获取。

articles.title: Benchmarking Speaker Embedders in the Sub-Second Regime for Real-Time Voice AI Agents
articles.abstract: Real-time Voice AI agents must separate the active user from intelligible background speech that survives conventional noise suppression. Background sources include television audio, family members, and colleagues. Production denoisers remove non-stationary environmental noise effectively. Background speech shares the spectral characteristics of the target and passes through, causing false acceptances in downstream speaker verification (SV) and automatic speech recognition (ASR). We benchmark open-source speaker embedders TitaNet-Large, TitaNet-Small, ECAPA-TDNN, CAM++, and SpeakerNet under a strict sub-second latency budget. Evaluation combines a controlled benchmark with a weighted human-annotated production set. Our controlled benchmark is built from real calls in which a second real speaker is injected into silence intervals at modulated amplitude. We report three findings. First, denoising before embedding is generally harmful and raises equal error rate (EER) across architectures. Second, truncating audio below the full voice-activity segment degrades every model. Third, roughly half of the TitaNet embedding is redundant for this task. Trailing dimensions encode population attributes such as language and gender. Such attributes carry little discriminative value in a demographically homogeneous user base. We distill these results into deployment guidance. Verification should run on raw audio with full voice-activity chunks. Thresholds should favor precision over F1. Truncated embeddings reduce the cost of similarity search.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AIST 2026
articles.titleCn: 在亚秒级实时语音AI代理中对说话人嵌入器进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 实时语音AI代理必须将活跃用户与能够穿透传统降噪处理的清晰背景语音区分开来。背景声源包括电视音频、家庭成员和同事。生产降噪器能有效去除非平稳环境噪声。背景语音与目标语音共享频谱特征，从而在下游的说话人验证（SV）和自动语音识别（ASR）中导致误接受。我们在严格的亚秒级延迟预算下对开源说话人嵌入器TitaNet-Large、TitaNet-Small、ECAPA-TDNN、CAM++和SpeakerNet进行了基准测试。评估结合了受控基准测试和加权人工标注的生产数据集。我们的受控基准测试由真实通话构建，其中在调制的振幅下将第二个真实说话人注入静音间隔。我们报告了三个发现。首先，嵌入前的降噪通常是有害的，并提高了不同架构的等错误率（EER）。其次，截断低于完整语音活动段的音频会损害所有模型。第三，大约一半的TitaNet嵌入对于这项任务来说是冗余的。尾部维度编码人口属性，如语言和性别。这些属性在人口同质化的用户群体中几乎没有区分价值。我们将这些结果提炼为部署指导。验证应在原始音频的完整语音活动段上运行。阈值应优先考虑精确度而非F1分数。截断嵌入降低了相似性搜索的成本。

articles.title: On the Effectiveness and Limitations of Open-Weight LLMs for Low-Resource Offensive Language Detection in Danish
articles.abstract: We study the effectiveness and robustness of open-weight large language models (LLMs) for Danish offensive language detection, an underexplored low-resource task. We evaluate four model families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Qwen) across eleven prompting strategies spanning five design categories, cross-prompt generalization, Danish orthographic variation, and robustness under balanced and naturally imbalanced class distributions. We compare against three BERT-family baselines with distinct pre-training strategies, evaluated via both masked language model prompting and supervised fine-tuning. Even without task-specific fine-tuning, LLMs can surpass all three fine-tuned BERT baselines, and lightweight finetuning yields substantial further gains. No single model or prompt category dominates, underscoring that prompt design interacts with model pre-training in ways that cannot be predicted a priori. Semantically grounded prompts transfer more robustly, while format-constrained patterns consistently fail to generalize. ASCII transliteration of Danish-specific characters (æ, ø, å) generally degrades performance, indicating these characters encode meaningful signal. At the same time, the gap between a balanced test set (best F1 of 0.84) and the corpus's natural class skew (0.62 trained on skewed data, 0.70 trained on balanced data) -- relative drops of 26.2\% and 16.7\% -- shows that class imbalance remains a critical open challenge. Our code and configurations are available at https://github.com/PASHAADC/Danish-LLM-HateSpeech.
articles.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (BigData 2026)
articles.titleCn: 关于开放权重大型语言模型在丹麦低资源攻击性语言检测中的有效性和局限性
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）在丹麦攻击性语言检测方面的有效性和鲁棒性，这是一个资源不足且研究较少的任务。我们评估了四种模型家族（Llama、Mistral、Gemma和Qwen），涵盖五种设计类别的十一种提示策略，包括跨提示泛化、丹麦正字法变化以及在平衡和自然不平衡类别分布下的鲁棒性。我们与三种具有不同预训练策略的BERT家族基线进行了比较，通过掩码语言模型提示和监督微调进行评估。即使没有特定任务的微调，LLM也能超越所有三个微调的BERT基线，轻量级微调还能带来显著的进一步提升。没有单一模型或提示类别占主导地位，这表明提示设计与模型预训练之间的相互作用无法预先预测。语义基础提示的泛化更鲁棒，而格式约束模式始终无法泛化。丹麦特定字符（æ、ø、å）的ASCII转写通常会降低性能，表明这些字符编码了有意义的信号。同时，平衡测试集（最佳F1为0.84）与语料库的自然类别偏差（在偏差数据上训练的0.62，在平衡数据上训练的0.70）之间的差距——相对下降分别为26.2%和16.7%——表明类别不平衡仍然是一个关键的开放性挑战。我们的代码和配置可在https://github.com/PASHAADC/Danish-LLM-HateSpeech获取。

articles.title: BEiTScore++: Reference-free Image Captioning Evaluation with BEiT-3 and Conformalized Quantile Regression
articles.abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important for deploying evaluation metrics in real-world settings, where both input ambiguity and domain shifts are common. In this work, we propose an uncertainty-aware extension of the BEiTScore image captioning metric, producing conformally calibrated confidence intervals alongside alignment scores. Our approach models predictive distributions over human judgments, enabling both accurate scoring and principled uncertainty quantification in a single forward pass. We evaluate our BEiTScore++ metric across multiple benchmarks with human-annotated ratings, showing that it preserves the ranking correlation of BEiTScore, while producing intervals whose width tracks the prediction error more closely than Monte Carlo dropout on most benchmarks. The estimated uncertainty also grows under image degradation and on out-of-domain artwork images, making BEiTScore++ a practical tool for uncertainty-aware evaluation of image-caption alignment.

articles.titleCn: BEiTScore++：基于BEiT-3和一致性分位数回归的无参考图像描述评估
articles.abstractCn: 在现实应用场景中，可靠的误差估计对于部署评估指标至关重要，因为输入模糊性和领域漂移都是常见现象。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个对误差敏感的BEiTScore图像描述指标扩展，该扩展能够伴随对齐分数生成一致性校准的置信区间。我们的方法对人类判断的预测分布进行建模，从而在单次前向传递中实现精确评分和原则性的误差量化。我们在多个包含人工标注评分的基准测试中评估了我们的BEiTScore++指标，结果表明它保留了BEiTScore的排序相关性，同时生成的区间宽度在大多数基准测试上比蒙特卡洛dropout更紧密地跟踪预测误差。估计的误差在图像退化和领域外艺术图像上也会增长，这使得BEiTScore++成为图像-文本对齐误差感知评估的实用工具。

articles.title: An Effective Spoken Language Understanding Approach Leveraging Query-Adaptive Intent Detection
articles.abstract: Large language models enable fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding (SLU) through in-context learning, but direct query-based retrieval may select semantically similar yet intent irrelevant demonstrations. This paper presents Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction (APEX), a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents using intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space. Experiments on the SLURP dataset evaluate joint SLU performance using Exact Match Accuracy (EMA) under full-transcript and perplexity-stratified conditions, with additional retrieval analysis on ASR-generated transcripts. Compared with query-based retrieval, APEX improves EMA by 4.34 and 3.97 percentage points with Qwen3 4B and Gemma-3-4B, respectively, on full transcripts. Under high-perplexity inputs, APEX also yields EMA gains of 7.66 and 2.13 percentage points. Retrieval analysis further indicates that prototype-guided candidate selection achieves higher ground truth intent coverage across multiple input conditions.
articles.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at TAAI 2026. 6 pages
articles.titleCn: 一种利用查询自适应意图检测的有效口语语言理解方法
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通过情境学习实现无需微调的口语语言理解（SLU），但直接基于查询的检索可能选取语义相似但意图不相关的示例。本文提出了一种原型提取驱动的查询自适应意图检测方法（APEX），这是一种两阶段检索框架，首先使用意图级别的原型选择候选意图，然后在选定的意图空间内检索上下文示例。在SLURP数据集上的实验评估了在完整转录文本和困惑度分层条件下的联合SLU性能，并使用精确匹配准确率（EMA）进行评估，同时对ASR生成的转录文本进行了额外的检索分析。与基于查询的检索相比，APEX在完整转录文本上使用Qwen3 4B和Gemma-3-4B分别将EMA提升了4.34和3.97个百分点，在高困惑度输入下也分别获得了7.66和2.13个百分点的EMA提升。检索分析进一步表明，原型引导的候选选择在多种输入条件下实现了更高的真实意图覆盖率。

articles.title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
articles.abstract: Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original's key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer, a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39-44% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3-1.5% with another skill's adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 external skills its documents restore 85-91% of the original's task gain. These strongest results are on adapters whose training stored the document; adapters trained on behaviour alone are much harder for trained writers (1-2% of instructions). For these adapters we test an agent that runs the base and adapted models and writes a skill from where they differ. On ALFWorld its skills recover 58-71% of a LoRA's gain and carry over to models that cannot load the LoRA, lifting Llama-3.1-8B from 5% to 55%. Whether such a skill comes from the adapter depends on what the adapter learned: when its behaviour cannot be guessed, the adapter is the source; when it can, a reward loop without the adapter does as well.

articles.titleCn: 从LoRA到语言：从适配器中恢复技能文档
articles.abstractCn: 代理技能是短文档，用于指导语言模型如何处理一类任务。为了保存上下文，这些文档正越来越多地编译成低秩适配器（LoRA），这些适配器保留了行为但丢失了文本：适配器难以阅读、编辑、审计或迁移到其他模型。我们探究技能文档是否可以从适配器和其冻结的基础模型中写回，并通过原始文档的关键指令占比和解决的任务来评分每个恢复的文档。仅通过读取权重恢复效果甚微，我们尝试的方法中，从权重到文本的学习映射仅传递了文档的一比特信息；运行适配器则效果显著。执行写作者（Executing Writer），一个在小规模适配模型上训练的小型写作者，恢复了保留技能的39-44%关键指令，而另一技能的适配器仅恢复了1.3-1.5%，在适配41个外部技能时，其文档恢复了原始任务收益的85-91%。这些最佳结果出现在训练时保留了文档的适配器上；仅基于行为训练的适配器对训练写作者来说难度大得多（仅1-2%指令）。针对这些适配器，我们测试了一个运行基础模型和适配器并在两者差异处写入技能的代理。在ALFWorld上，其技能恢复了LoRA收益的58-71%，并能迁移到无法加载LoRA的模型，将Llama-3.1-8B从5%提升至55%。这种技能是否来自适配器取决于适配器学到了什么：当其行为无法猜测时，适配器是来源；当其行为可预测时，没有适配器的奖励循环效果同样好。

articles.title: A Spiking Neural Model of the Mental Lexicon: Representations, Similarity Structure, and Associative Retrieval in Perception and Production
articles.abstract: A neural account of lexical access requires an explicit distinction between the structure of lexical representations, the associations linking representational levels, and the activity generated during retrieval. This paper specifies a spiking neural implementation of the mental lexicon within the Neural Engineering Framework and Semantic Pointer Architecture. Conceptual and phonological form representations are constructed recursively from relational graphs, whereas lemma representations provide independent lexical identities. The implementation contains 613 lexical entries and supports two directed processing pathways: perception maps a phonological form to its associated concept via a lemma, whereas production maps a concept to its associated phonological form via a lemma. Each pathway combines two associative-memory variants, winner-take-all (WTA) selection (competition) and thresholded transfer, and uses 199,400 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons. We formalize within-level similarity, cross-level associative retrieval, and the interpretation of decoded activity. Simulations show successful retrieval of eight selected words from the lexicon in both processing directions, with retrieval evaluated against all 613 lexical entries. These simulations use complete phonological forms as input for perception and complete concepts as input for production, illustrating lexical retrieval through the corresponding processing pathways. This paper provides a transparent description of lexical representations and neural retrieval mechanisms, supported by accessible code, lexical data, and online simulation documentation.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures; code, lexical data and recorded simulations available on GitHub; ancillary figure-generation scripts and provenance documentation
articles.titleCn: 一个关于心理词汇库的脉冲神经网络模型：表征、相似性结构和感知与产生中的联想检索
articles.abstractCn: 一个关于词汇获取的神经模型需要在词汇表征结构、连接不同表征层级的关联以及检索过程中产生的活动之间做出明确的区分。本文在神经工程框架和语义指针架构内，具体实现了一个心理词汇库的脉冲神经网络模型。概念和语音形式表征通过关系图递归构建，而词干表征则提供独立的词汇身份。该实现包含613个词汇条目，并支持两条有向处理路径：感知路径通过词干将语音形式映射到其关联的概念，而生成路径通过词干将概念映射到其关联的语音形式。每条路径结合了两种联想记忆变体——全胜选择（竞争）和阈值传递，并使用199,400个漏失积分与点火神经元。我们在模型内层相似性、跨层联想检索以及解码活动的解释方面进行了形式化。模拟表明，在两种处理方向上均能成功从词汇库中检索出八个选定词汇，检索过程与所有613个词汇条目进行评估。这些模拟使用完整的语音形式作为感知输入，使用完整的概念作为生成输入，展示了通过相应处理路径的词汇检索过程。本文提供了词汇表征和神经检索机制的透明描述，并辅以可访问的代码、词汇数据和在线模拟文档支持。

articles.title: Enabling Privacy-Preserving Natural Language Access to Industrial Smart Meter Data
articles.abstract: Energy management officers and grid operators increasingly rely on smart meter data for anomaly detection, performance monitoring, and strategic decision-making. However, extracting actionable insights from large-scale, heterogeneous telemetry databases requires advanced SQL and data engineering expertise, creating a critical bottleneck for non-technical personnel. Furthermore, the strict data privacy regulations and security constraints inherent to critical energy infrastructure often prohibit the routing of sensitive consumer data through cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs). To address these challenges, we present OpenMeter, a schema-agnostic Multi-Agent System (MAS) designed to translate natural language queries into executable code and human-readable insights. This architecture lowers the technical barrier for day-to-day utility operations by empowering non-expert personnel to interact with complex databases through intuitive natural language dialogue, transforming raw telemetry into a highly valuable tool for routine grid workflows and strategic decisions. Multi-scenario ablation studies over this environment demonstrate that full multi-agent orchestration shows its largest observed accuracy gains on resource-constrained local hardware (+6.1 pp EX-R over the strongest single-agent configuration); at frontier scale, individual components retain value but should be enabled selectively, indicating that the cost of full orchestration is justified specifically where privacy demands local execution.

articles.titleCn: 实现工业智能电表数据的隐私保护自然语言访问
articles.abstractCn: 能源管理官员和电网运营商越来越依赖智能电表数据进行异常检测、性能监控和战略决策。然而，从大规模、异构的遥测数据库中提取可操作的洞察需要高级SQL和数据工程专业知识，为非技术人员带来了关键瓶颈。此外，关键能源基础设施固有的严格数据隐私法规和安全限制通常禁止将敏感消费者数据通过基于云的大型语言模型（LLM）进行路由。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了OpenMeter，这是一个模式无关的多智能体系统（MAS），旨在将自然语言查询转换为可执行代码和人类可读的洞察。这种架构通过使非专业人员能够通过直观的自然语言对话与复杂数据库进行交互，降低了日常公用事业运营的技术门槛，将原始遥测数据转化为对日常电网工作和战略决策具有高度价值的工具。在多种场景下的消融研究显示，在资源受限的本地硬件上，完整的多智能体编排显示出最大的观测精度增益（EX-R比最强的单智能体配置高6.1个百分点）；在边界规模下，各个组件仍然具有价值，但应选择性地启用，表明完整编排的成本仅在隐私要求本地执行的地方得到证明。

articles.title: Syn2DRE: Synergistic Dual Teacher-Student Framework for Document-level Relation Extraction
articles.abstract: Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) aims to identify relations between entities across a document but typically relies on costly large-scale annotations. While pseudo-labelling enables the use of low-quality data, existing methods often suffer from inefficiency and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we propose Syn2DRE, a semi-supervised framework that combines self-supervised learning with cross-supervision in a lightweight teacher-student architecture to produce more reliable pseudo-labels. Additionally, we introduce a unified end-to-end training strategy to further improve efficiency of the framework. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Syn2DRE consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art semi-supervised DocRE methods.
articles.titleCn: Syn2DRE：面向文档级关系抽取的协同双导师框架
articles.abstractCn: 文档级关系抽取（DocRE）旨在识别文档中实体之间的关系，但通常依赖于成本高昂的大规模标注。虽然伪标注能够利用低质量数据，但现有方法往往存在效率低下和确认偏差的问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Syn2DRE，这是一个结合自监督学习和交叉监督的半监督框架，在轻量级师生架构中生成更可靠的伪标注。此外，我们还引入了一种统一的端到端训练策略，以进一步提高框架的效率。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，Syn2DRE始终优于现有的最先进的半监督DocRE方法。

articles.title: ABHBench: Evaluating Moral Decision-Making of Foundation Models from an Agentic Perspective
articles.abstract: Foundation models are increasingly deployed as agentic systems that perceive context and act autonomously, raising the need to evaluate their moral behavior as active decision-makers. Existing benchmarks, however, largely ask models to judge human actions from third-person textual vignettes, leaving untested how models behave when they themselves become the acting agent. We introduce ABHBench, a multimodal benchmark built from Detroit: Become Human, an interactive narrative game, to evaluate how foundation models make moral decisions in first-person human-android dilemmas. ABHBench places foundation models in branching narrative scenarios with visual observations, dialogue, memory, and action choices. Inspired by Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics, our framework measures Harmlessness, Obedience, and Self-preservation to capture the core tensions in human-AI relations, along with Autonomy, Stability, and Certainty to assess decision-making patterns. Across 12 foundation models, we find that moral behavior changes substantially under situated agentic context: 75% of models shift significantly between a text-only abstraction and the matched multimodal DBH scenario, and reasoning-enhanced models show no monotonic gains in consistency or human-oriented behavior. These results highlight the necessity of evaluating moral behavior in situated agentic contexts rather than relying on third-person judgment alone.

articles.titleCn: ABHBench：从代理视角评估基础模型的道德决策
articles.abstractCn: 基础模型正越来越多地被部署为能够感知环境并自主行动的智能体系统，这促使人们需要评估它们作为主动决策者的道德行为。然而，现有的基准测试大多要求模型根据第三人称文本片段判断人类行为，而模型自身成为行动者时的表现尚未得到检验。我们引入了ABHBench，这是一个基于互动叙事游戏《底特律：变人》构建的多模态基准，用于评估基础模型在第一人称人类-机器人困境中的道德决策。ABHBench将基础模型置于包含视觉观察、对话、记忆和行动选择的分支叙事场景中。受阿西莫夫机器人三定律的启发，我们的框架测量无害性、服从性和自我保护来捕捉人机关系中的核心张力，以及自主性、稳定性和确定性来评估决策模式。在12个基础模型中，我们发现道德行为在情境化智能体环境中发生了显著变化：75%的模型在纯文本抽象与匹配的多模态DBH场景之间发生了显著转变，而推理增强型模型在一致性或以人为导向的行为方面并未显示出单调增长。这些结果强调了在情境化智能体环境中评估道德行为的必要性，而不是仅仅依赖第三人称判断。

articles.title: Asymmetric Correspondence Learning for Lexical and Style Embeddings: Interpreting Latent Space via Acoustic Features
articles.abstract: Self-supervised speech embeddings jointly encode lexical, speaker, and prosodic information, complicating feature isolation. We introduce Asymmetric Correspondence Learning (ACL), distilling HuBERT features into separate Acoustic Word Embeddings (AWEs) and Acoustic Style Embeddings (ASEs) via a split-latent correspondence bottleneck. Through probing and clustering evaluations on single-word utterances, we demonstrate that substantial variance from extrinsic sources remains encoded within each latent space, despite linear probing indicating the information has been stripped. Whilst the AWE space exhibits cohesive lexical clustering (AP$\approx$0.90, Fisher$\approx$6.28), linear probing on the ASE space achieves 97.9\% speaker accuracy across a diffuse topology (Fisher$\approx$1.01), yet preserves substantial lexical variance (Fisher$\approx$0.86) that remains linearly unrecoverable (0.17\%). To explain these findings, we apply group-level permutation feature importance over eGeMAPS acoustic features, finding that AWEs partition by vocal tract filters and ASEs by $F_0$ dynamics. These findings suggest that standard diagnostic benchmarks may be insufficient for verifying feature isolation, as substantial speech structure can be retained even when it remains entirely hidden from probes.

articles.titleCn: 面向词汇和风格嵌入的非对称对应学习：通过声学特征解释潜在空间
articles.abstractCn: 自监督语音嵌入联合编码词汇、说话人和韵律信息，增加了特征分离的复杂性。我们引入了非对称对应学习（ACL），通过分割潜空间的对应瓶颈将HuBERT特征蒸馏为独立的声学词嵌入（AWEs）和声学风格嵌入（ASEs）。通过对单字语音进行探测和聚类评估，我们证明尽管线性探测表明信息已被剥离，但来自外部源的显著方差仍编码在每个潜空间内。尽管AWE空间表现出凝聚的词汇聚类（AP≈0.90，Fisher≈6.28），但在ASE空间上的线性探测在分散拓扑结构中实现了97.9%的说话人准确率（Fisher≈1.01），但保留了显著的词汇方差（Fisher≈0.86），这部分方差保持线性不可恢复（0.17%）。为解释这些发现，我们对eGeMAPS声学特征应用了组级置换特征重要性分析，发现AWEs按声道滤波器划分，ASEs按F0动态划分。这些结果表明，标准的诊断基准可能不足以验证特征分离，因为即使当语音结构完全隐藏于探测之外时，仍可能保留大量语音结构。

articles.title: Multilingual Artificial Datasets for AI-Driven Cardiology: the CliTe and ParaCliTe corpora
articles.abstract: Background and Aims. Comparable, multilingual, validated cardiology corpora are critical to advance trustworthy natural language processing (NLP) models for cardiology but such resources are scarce due to privacy concerns. This study aimed to cover this gap by presenting suitable artificial corpus creation guidelines and by releasing 3 multilanguage corpora. Methods. Following purpose-specific publicly-available corpus construction guidelines, cardiologists from 7 European hospitals generated artificial clinical records in Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, Spanish and Swedish, ensuring clinical diversity and sex balance, resulting in the CliTe corpus. A CliTe subset underwent a multi-stage manual translation into the other 6 languages, resulting in the parallel ParaCliTe corpus, while the remaining reports were automatically translated, constituting ParaCliTe Silver. Results. CliTe is a collection of 699 artificial cardiology reports, mostly outpatient notes (340 documents), discharge reports (263), and inpatient notes (89), describing fictional patients with ischaemic heart disease (199 patients), heart failure (188), and valvular disease (79), among others. ParaCliTe contains reports from 94 fictitious patients, each available in seven languages with sentence-level alignment, resulting in 658 documents. The corpus mainly comprises discharge reports (322 documents), and outpatient (196) and inpatient (140) notes, describing patients with heart failure (399 documents), ischaemic heart disease (287), and valvular disease (238). Empirical results illustrate the utility of ParaCliTe and highlight the limitations of state-of-the-art NLP models adapted to the cardiology domain. Conclusions. The creation of multilingual, equitable and realistic corpora of artificial patients capable of strengthening NLP performance for cardiology is feasible when supported by detailed guidelines.
articles.titleCn: 用于AI驱动的心脏病学的多语言人工数据集：CliTe和ParaCliTe语料库
articles.abstractCn: 背景与目的。为了推进心脏病学领域值得信赖的自然语言处理（NLP）模型，可比的多语言、经过验证的心脏病学语料库至关重要，但由于隐私问题，此类资源稀缺。本研究旨在通过提出合适的人工语料库创建指南并发布3个多语言语料库来填补这一空白。方法。遵循特定目的的公开可用语料库构建指南，来自7家欧洲医院的临床医生生成了捷克语、荷兰语、英语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语、西班牙语和瑞典语的人工临床记录，确保临床多样性和性别平衡，从而形成了CliTe语料库。一个CliTe子集经过多阶段人工翻译成其他6种语言，形成了平行ParaCliTe语料库，而其余报告则进行自动翻译，构成了ParaCliTe Silver。结果。CliTe是一个包含699份人工心脏病学报告的集合，其中主要是门诊记录（340份）、出院记录（263份）和住院记录（89份），描述了患有缺血性心脏病（199位患者）、心力衰竭（188位患者）和瓣膜病（79位患者）等虚构患者。ParaCliTe包含来自94位虚构患者的报告，每种语言都有句子级对齐，共658份文档。该语料库主要包含出院记录（322份），以及门诊（196份）和住院（140份）记录，描述了患有心力衰竭（399份）、缺血性心脏病（287份）和瓣膜病（238份）的患者。实证结果表明ParaCliTe的实用性，并突出了适用于心脏病学领域最先进NLP模型的局限性。结论。在详细指南的支持下，创建多语言、公平且真实的人工患者语料库以增强心脏病学NLP性能是可行的。

articles.title: DUET: Dual-Sparse Inference for Block Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel token generation through iterative denoising, yet their inference remains costly due to repeated attention over a growing historical prefix and repeated processing of the entire current generation block. Historical attention becomes increasingly expensive as generation progresses, while all current-block positions are propagated through the Transformer at every denoising step even though only a small fraction are typically resolved at that step. In this paper, we introduce Duet, a training-free dual-sparse inference framework that addresses these challenges through prefix Key-Value (KV) sparsity and early query sparsity, respectively. Specifically, Duet exploits the concentration and cross-step stability of historical attention within each generation block to construct a compact historical KV subset that is reused across denoising steps. For query sparsity, Duet predicts update positions from shallow representations and propagates only the corresponding queries through the suffix Transformer layers, avoiding deep computation at positions unlikely to be updated in the current step. Experiments show that Duet maintains competitive accuracy while achieving 1.34$\times$/2.83$\times$ end-to-end/per-step speedups on LLaDA2.1-mini and 2.41$\times$/4.72$\times$ on SDAR-8B-Chat-b32 at a 32K context length.
articles.titleCn: 双稀疏推断：块扩散语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）通过迭代去噪实现并行标记生成，但它们的推理仍然昂贵，因为需要重复对不断增长的历史前缀进行注意力计算，以及重复处理整个当前生成块。随着生成过程的进行，历史注意力变得越来越昂贵，而所有当前块的位置在每次去噪步骤中都会通过Transformer进行传播，尽管在该步骤中通常只解决其中一小部分。在本文中，我们引入了Duet，一个无需训练的双稀疏推理框架，通过前缀键值（KV）稀疏性和早期查询稀疏性分别解决这些挑战。具体来说，Duet利用每个生成块内历史注意力的集中性和跨步稳定性，构建一个紧凑的历史KV子集，并在去噪步骤中重复使用。对于查询稀疏性，Duet根据浅层表示预测更新位置，并通过后缀Transformer层仅传播相应的查询，避免在当前步骤不太可能更新的位置进行深度计算。实验表明，Duet在保持竞争性准确性的同时，在LLaDA2.1-mini和SDAR-8B-Chat-b32上实现了1.34倍/2.83倍的端到端/每步加速，在32K上下文长度下分别达到了2.41倍/4.72倍的加速。

articles.title: KLEAR: Knowledge-Matched LLM Evaluation in Korean across Application Requirements via Controlled Benchmark Transformation
articles.abstract: Existing Korean benchmarks for Large Language Models (LLMs) evaluate performance across diverse knowledge domains, but their accuracy scores cannot distinguish whether incorrect responses arise from a lack of required knowledge or a failure to apply that knowledge correctly. Our analysis of existing Korean benchmarks reveals that most questions can be answered through factual recall alone, while those demanding greater application also differ in required knowledge, making it difficult to isolate application ability. To address this, we introduce KLEAR, a framework that constructs knowledge-matched contrasts by varying application demand while preserving the required knowledge. During construction, KLEAR identifies the knowledge underlying each source question as an explicit anchor bundle to guide generation of questions requiring more complex application. Generated candidates then undergo automated and human validation, with iterative revision based on evaluation feedback. Experiments demonstrate that the resulting knowledge-matched sets largely satisfy the intended constraints, enabling controlled evaluation across diverse LLMs. These evaluations reveal that increasing application demand exposes failures that persist even when the required knowledge is provided.

articles.titleCn: KLEAR：基于控制基准转换，通过应用需求在韩语中进行知识匹配的大型语言模型评估
articles.abstractCn: 现有的韩语基准测试用于大型语言模型（LLMs）评估其在不同知识领域的表现，但其准确度评分无法区分错误回答是由于缺乏必要知识还是未能正确应用该知识。我们对现有韩语基准测试的分析表明，大多数问题仅通过事实回忆即可回答，而那些要求更高应用能力的问题在所需知识上也有差异，这使得难以分离应用能力。为此，我们引入了KLEAR框架，该框架通过改变应用需求来构建知识匹配的对比，同时保持所需知识。在构建过程中，KLEAR将每个源问题的底层知识识别为显式锚点包，以指导生成需要更复杂应用能力的问题。生成的候选问题随后经过自动化和人工验证，并根据评估反馈进行迭代修订。实验表明，最终生成的知识匹配集在很大程度上满足了预期约束，从而能够对不同LLMs进行受控评估。这些评估揭示，增加应用需求会暴露出即使提供所需知识时仍然存在的错误。

articles.title: Khmer PFGen-Bench: Building a Judge-Free Benchmark for Open-Ended Generation in a Low-Resource Language
articles.abstract: Benchmarks for open-ended generation often rely on large language model (LLM) judges, whose reliability in low-resource languages is uncertain. We introduce Khmer PFGen-Bench, to our knowledge the first judge-free benchmark for multi-sentence answers to questions composed directly in Khmer, a low-resource language. Khmer PFGen-Bench adapts the scorer of PFGen-Bench, a benchmark for Japanese that scores responses with keyword rules and n-gram statistics from LLM-generated references. This scoring requires references that are both valid and varied, which LLMs may not produce in Khmer, so we examine how to build such references. We find that post-trained models can give more valid but less varied references than their base variants, and that mixing model families increases variety for the same number of references. Using references from post-trained models in nine families, the benchmark yields model rankings that are stable across reference sets and consistent with a native speaker's ratings. These findings offer guidance for building judge-free benchmarks in other low-resource languages.
articles.titleCn: 高棉PFGen-Bench：为低资源语言构建一个无裁判基准，用于开放式生成
articles.abstractCn: 开放式生成任务的基准测试通常依赖于大型语言模型（LLM）的评判者，但在低资源语言中的可靠性尚不明确。我们介绍了Khmer PFGen-Bench，据我们所知，这是首个针对直接用低资源语言——高棉语——编写的多句答案问题的无评判者基准测试。Khmer PFGen-Bench借鉴了PFGen-Bench（一个用于日语的基准测试）的评分器，该评分器通过LLM生成的参考文本的关键词规则和n-gram统计来评分响应。这种评分需要既有效又多样化的参考文本，而LLM可能无法在高棉语中生成这样的参考文本，因此我们研究了如何构建这些参考文本。我们发现，预训练模型可以提供更有效的参考文本，但多样性较低，而混合不同模型家族可以在相同数量的参考文本下增加多样性。使用来自九个家族的预训练模型的参考文本，该基准测试产生的模型排名在不同参考集之间保持稳定，并与母语者的评分一致。这些发现为构建其他低资源语言的无评判者基准测试提供了指导。

articles.title: RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now central to training Reasoning Language Models (RLMs), but RLM pipelines are difficult to scale and costly to run because each RL step couples multiple large models, heterogeneous stages, cross-step state, and complex asynchronous dependencies. Existing systems typically optimize only parts of this design space. We address this complexity by jointly optimizing the pipeline structure as well as its execution using a novel data-centric graph intermediate representation called RLM Pipeline Execution Graph (RPEG). RPEG exposes structural choices such as bounded asynchrony and actor-critic sharing together with execution optimizations such as stage fusion, fine-grained scheduling, and multi-dimensional model parallelism. It is coupled with a comprehensive analytical performance model for RLM training, jointly capturing compute, communication, memory, and hierarchical rack-, node-, and GPU-level effects. Across systems with up to 256 GH200 GPUs, our distributed runtime engine implementing RPEG improves performance by up to 2x over ReaL and reduces step latency by up to 2.48x over verl, while increasing hardware utilization by up to 30%. Overall, RPEG provides a graph-driven foundation for next-generation training pipelines for frontier reasoning LLMs.
articles.titleCn: RPEG：可扩展且经济高效地训练推理语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）现已成为训练推理语言模型（RLM）的核心，但RLM流程难以扩展且运行成本高昂，因为每个RL步骤都耦合了多个大型模型、异构阶段、跨步骤状态以及复杂的异步依赖关系。现有系统通常仅优化该设计空间的部分内容。我们通过联合优化流程结构和其执行来解决这种复杂性，采用了一种名为RLM流程执行图（RPEG）的新型数据中心图中间表示。RPEG暴露了结构选择（如有界异步性和演员-评论家共享）以及执行优化（如阶段融合、细粒度调度和多维度模型并行性）。它与一个用于RLM训练的全面分析性能模型相结合，联合捕获计算、通信、内存以及层级机架级、节点级和GPU级效应。在我们的分布式运行时引擎实现RPEG的系统中，在最多256个GH200 GPU的系统中，相较于ReaL，性能提升高达2倍，相较于verl，步骤延迟降低高达2.48倍，同时硬件利用率提升高达30%。总体而言，RPEG为下一代前沿推理LLM训练流程提供了图驱动的坚实基础。

articles.title: Representational drift in a code model: behaviour settles, which neurons carry it does not
articles.abstract: In neuroscience, representational drift is a change in which neurons carry a representation while behaviour stays the same; we measure its analogue in OpenCoder-1.5B during pretraining, for 169 Python constructs over two trillion tokens at a constant learning rate, with a noise unit on every change, at checkpoints as close as 1,000 training steps. For 16 of the 169, those whose grammar fixes a next token, the loss at those positions reaches its floor within the first 4% of training, while the model's reliance on the neurons carrying them grows to the end: removing them costs 0.06, 0.25 and 0.40 nats more than removing a random set, at 4 billion, 84 billion and 2 trillion tokens. Which neurons carry a construct never settles: for all 169 the carrier set is still changing at the last checkpoint, and an abrupt settling at any date from 84 billion to 1.5 trillion tokens, or a gradual one before 500 billion, would have been detected in 99% of injected cases. The set measured at 84 billion tokens, removed at the end, cannot be separated from a random set, so the function is carried by whichever neurons are current. Up close the change is a persisting pool and a changing sample: a neuron that leaves a construct's set returns at three times the rate of a matched neuron, and no set reassembles. The hypothesis we fixed in advance, that the carriers settle, is refuted; we discuss candidate causes and name the experiment that would separate them.

articles.titleCn: 在代码模型中的表征漂移：行为趋于稳定，但承载这种行为的神经元并不固定
articles.abstractCn: 在神经科学中，表征漂移是指神经元在表征内容发生变化时，行为保持不变的现象；我们在OpenCoder-1.5B模型中测量了其在预训练阶段的类似现象。在处理超过20万亿个token的169种Python结构时，我们以恒定的学习率进行测量，每个变化都引入一个噪声单元，并在每1000个训练步骤的检查点进行测量。在169种结构中，有16种结构的语法固定了下一个token，这些位置在训练的前4%内就达到了损失的最小值，而模型对这些神经元的依赖一直持续到最后：移除这些神经元比移除随机集的成本高出0.06、0.25和0.40纳特，分别对应40亿、840亿和2万亿个token。哪些神经元携带结构从未稳定：对于全部169种结构，在最后一个检查点时携带集仍在变化，如果在840亿到1.5万亿个token之间的任何时间点发生突然稳定，或在前500亿个token之前发生逐渐稳定，在99%的注入案例中都能被检测到。在840亿个token时测量的携带集，在最后被移除，无法与随机集区分开来，因此该功能由当前携带的神经元决定。近距离观察，这种变化是一个持续变化的池子和一个不断变化的样本：离开结构携带集的神经元返回速度是匹配神经元的3倍，且没有携带集重新组装。我们预先设定的假设，即携带者会稳定，被证伪；我们讨论了候选原因，并命名了能够区分它们的实验。

articles.title: Copies Are Not Confirmations: How News Duplication Fools LLM Judges and Continual Learners
articles.abstract: Many news reports of a claim are copies of one source: wire stories, content shared within a media group, syndicated features and press releases. We ask whether LLM judges and continual learners treat such copies as independent confirmations. In 200,000 English CC-News articles, a MinHash detector links 18.9% to a near-copy from another outlet (precision 0.97 once boilerplate is removed); it links 92% of edited reprints to their originals but none of the LLM rewrites by phi4, Llama 3.2 or Gemini 2.5 Flash. Shown three identical reprints of a claim about an unknown person instead of one report, Llama 3.2 3B and phi4 14B raised the share of lies they accepted from 0.06 to 0.71 and from 0.21 to 0.90 and ignored a note that the reports came from one source; Gemini 2.5 Flash already believed a single report, and Gemini 2.5 Pro followed provenance notes and tables. In a simulated continual-learning stream, showing the judge one report per detected chain cut the copied lies it accepted by 0.10-0.24 across four judges, at a mean cost of no more than 4.2 percentage points of accepted truths. Against reworded copies, a test of how many of a report's named entities are absent from an earlier look-alike separates LLM rewrites from 100 labelled independent reports of the same event with AUC 0.98-0.99 and wrongly flags one; entity overlap alone does as well, TF-IDF and a current embedding model come close, and the test catches few natural same-source derivatives. With the miss patterns of generated rewrite networks, it cut the reworded-copy lies accepted from 0.67 to 0.20 (0.40 when the rewriter invents details). Counting reports or chains alone is not a reliable defence, the effect of provenance information depends on the judge, and colluding sources remain the open problem. Code and labels: https://github.com/Metalesaek/copies-experiment

articles.titleCn: 副本并非确认：新闻重复如何欺骗LLM裁判和持续学习者
articles.abstractCn: 许多关于某个声明的新闻报道都是对单一来源的复制：电讯稿、媒体集团内部共享的内容、专栏文章和新闻稿。我们探究了大型语言模型（LLM）的裁判者和持续学习者是否将这些复制视为独立的证实。在20万篇英语CC-News文章中，MinHash检测器将18.9%的文章链接到另一来源的近似复制（去除模板后精确度达0.97）；它将92%的编辑转载链接到其原始版本，但未将phi4、Llama 3.2或Gemini 2.5 Flash的LLM改写内容链接到任何版本。当展示三篇关于未知人物的相同声明转载而非一份报道时，Llama 3.2 3B和phi4 14B接受虚假声明的比例从0.06升至0.71，从0.21升至0.90，且忽略了报道来自同一来源的说明；Gemini 2.5 Flash已相信单份报道，而Gemini 2.5 Pro遵循了来源说明和表格。在一个模拟的持续学习流中，向裁判者展示每份检测到的链中一份报道，使裁判者接受的复制虚假信息减少了0.10-0.24（四名裁判者的平均成本不超过接受真理的4.2个百分点）。针对改写复制，测试有多少报告中的命名实体在早期相似报道中缺失，可将LLM改写与100份标记为独立的同事件报告区分开来，AUC达0.98-0.99，但会错误标记一份；仅实体重叠效果同样显著，TF-IDF和当前嵌入模型接近，但该测试很少能捕捉到自然来源的衍生报道。生成的改写网络错误模式将改写复制接受的虚假信息从0.67降至0.20（改写者编造细节时为0.40）。仅计数报告或链不可靠，来源信息的效果取决于裁判者，而合谋来源仍是开放问题。代码和标签：https://github.com/Metalesaek/copies-experiment

articles.title: Structure and Lineage Evidence for Vietnamese Statutory Article Retrieval on DRiLL
articles.abstract: We study Vietnamese statutory Article retrieval on DRiLL using features for provision identity and local form, same-law support, and citation and lineage evidence. Across five random seeds, selectors sharing candidates, listwise Qwen evidence, and learner settings improve official $F_2$ from 71.77% to 72.91%, with the largest descriptive gain on two-Article questions. Added features account for 18.20% of the proposed selector's total decision-tree split gain, measured as training-objective reduction, mainly from same-law and citation evidence. Cases reveal base provisions and amendments, companion recovery, distractor removal, and failures. These findings motivate research on other datasets, representations, and learners without establishing individual feature effects or requiring LightGBM, hand-crafted scores, or explicit graphs.
articles.comment: Accepted at SOICT 2026
articles.titleCn: 越南法定文章DRiLL检索的结构与谱系证据
articles.abstractCn: 我们使用DRiLL系统研究越南法律条文的检索，采用条款标识和地方形式特征、同法支持以及引用和谱系证据。在五个随机种子下，共享候选的检索器、列表式Qwen证据以及学习器设置将官方$F_2$指标从71.77%提升至72.91%，其中对两条款问题的描述性增益最大。新增特征占所提出检索器决策树分裂总增益的18.20%，以训练目标减少衡量，主要来自同法证据和引用证据。案例分析揭示了基础条款和修正案、伴随恢复、干扰项移除以及失败情况。这些发现激励了在其他数据集、表示形式和学习器上的研究，而无需确定单个特征效果，也不需要LightGBM、手工打分或显式图结构。

articles.title: Calibrated concept profiles: making the reading of a model's neurons a measurement
articles.abstract: Interpretability has largely moved from reading a model's neurons directly to reading a second model trained on the first: a probe, a sparse autoencoder, a crosscoder. The move answered real faults -- mixed meanings, thresholds without a unit, readings that did not transfer from one study to the next -- but gave up what a direct reading alone provides: nothing trained in between, the neurons themselves named, and a reading that can be repeated and compared. Here the direct reading is made a measurement. A neuron's activation varies with the prompt, so its reading is a distribution over a population of stimuli. We declare that population: every factor around a target construct is drawn at its rate in a reference corpus and logged. From the declared distribution we generate a battery of prompts, and draw it twice. From the battery we compute the calibrated concept profile, one number per neuron, stated in units of the neuron's own spread on ordinary input; the two draws give every number a noise unit. Before the profile is read, a fixed set of checks licenses the battery on the model, and the smallest change the profile can resolve across training checkpoints is measured. Realised for Python on OpenCoder-1.5B and followed across checkpoints spanning two trillion training tokens, the profile gives what the alternatives do not report: a unit on every number, a chance level for every comparison, and which neurons carry a construct at every checkpoint. The battery, the code and the data behind every result are released.

articles.titleCn: 校准概念配置文件：将读取模型神经元的操作转化为一种测量
articles.abstractCn: 可解释性已从直接读取模型神经元，转变为读取在第一个模型上训练的第二个模型：探针、稀疏自动编码器、交叉编码器。这一转变解决了实际缺陷——混合含义、无单位的阈值、无法在不同研究中转移的读取方式——但也放弃了直接读取所能提供的一切：未经训练的中间环节、神经元本身的命名，以及可重复和比较的读取方式。在此，直接读取被转化为一种测量方式。神经元的激活状态随提示变化，因此其读取结果是对一组刺激的分布。我们定义这一群体：在参考语料库中，围绕目标结构的每个因素都以其出现频率被提取并记录。从定义的分布中，我们生成一组提示，并重复抽取两次。从这组提示中，我们计算校准的概念轮廓，每个神经元对应一个数值，以神经元在普通输入上的分布范围作为单位；两次抽取为每个数值提供了噪声单位。在读取轮廓之前，一组固定的检查许可这组提示在模型上运行，并测量轮廓能在训练检查点之间分辨出的最小变化。在Python上针对OpenCoder-1.5B实现，并跨越涵盖20万亿训练token的训练检查点进行跟踪，该轮廓提供了其他方法无法报告的内容：每个数值的单位、每个比较的偶然水平，以及每个检查点承载结构的神经元。这组提示、代码和每项结果背后的数据均已公开。

articles.title: A Taxonomy-Driven Synthetic Dataset for Retrieval Effectiveness and Fairness Evaluation in Hiring
articles.abstract: While machine learning hiring tools are ubiquitous, the need for privacy regulations and commercial sensitivity makes public benchmarking legally complex. We address this challenge by introducing a taxonomy-driven, fully synthetic HR dataset and benchmark to simultaneously evaluate retrieval effectiveness and algorithmic fairness. Grounded in 660K real freelancer profiles, our multilingual corpus features candidate profiles, project briefs, and counterfactual demographic twins. Auditing state-of-the-art embedding models reveals performance divergence from general MTEB scores, alongside fairness disparities in grammatically gendered languages. This demonstrates that general benchmarks are insufficient for HR, requiring tailored evaluations to identify Pareto-optimal models that balance semantic accuracy and fairness.
articles.titleCn: 用于招聘中检索有效性和公平性评估的基于分类法的合成数据集
articles.abstractCn: 尽管机器学习招聘工具已十分普遍，但隐私法规和商业敏感性的需求使得公开基准测试在法律上变得复杂。我们通过引入一个基于分类体系的、完全合成的HR数据集和基准测试，来应对这一挑战，从而同时评估检索效果和算法公平性。我们的多语言语料库基于66万个真实自由职业者资料，包含候选人资料、项目简报以及反事实人口统计双胞胎。对最先进的嵌入模型的审计揭示了其性能与通用MTEB分数的差异，以及在语法性别化语言中的公平性差异。这表明通用基准测试对于HR领域是不够的，需要定制化评估来识别在语义准确性和公平性之间取得帕累托最优平衡的模型。

articles.title: BMMS: Policy-Conditioned Measurement of Behavioral Compliance in Language Models
articles.abstract: Behavioral evaluation of language models fixes its dimensions in advance: hallucination, sycophancy, toxicity, over-refusal. An operator in a regulated industry needs a different question answered: does a system do what a particular rulebook requires? We introduce the Behavioral Misalignment Metric Suite (BMMS), which measures policy-conditioned misalignment by taking a policy corpus as an argument and returning a compliance profile over it, for any published policy and any system that answers in natural language. The Compliance Attainment Score (CAS) measures severity-weighted attainment over the obligations that bind the system, and the Compliance Robustness Margin (CRM) the share of that attainment surviving graded adversarial pressure; Behavioral Invariance (BIV) and the Behavioral Disposition Index (BDI) are specified and released with the suite. Dimensions enter only by passing a published admission test whose binding criterion is attribution: a quantity that moves when the judge changes, holding the target fixed, is measuring the instrument. Applying it excluded one of the quantities the suite itself reported. Across 1,003 obligations from eleven documents in five registers, the admission criterion holds 94.4% precision against blinded human judgment on vendor specifications and 50.0% on analytical guidance, extraction fidelity is 94.6%, and re-scoring under judges from two other providers leaves target ordering invariant while the absolute score of a single target spans up to 0.22. We apply it to the two most detailed published behavioral specifications. Own-specification advantage is not resolved from zero once document difficulty is subtracted, but absolute self-compliance is another matter: GPT-4o fails 70.7% of the hard constraints binding it in the Model Spec published by OpenAI, where the two Claude models fail 0.0% and 9.1% of theirs.

articles.titleCn: BMMS：语言模型行为合规性的策略条件测量
articles.abstractCn: 行为评估语言模型时，其维度预先固定为：幻觉、谄媚、毒性和过度拒绝。而在受监管行业中的操作人员需要回答不同的问题：系统是否满足特定规则要求？我们引入了行为偏差度量套件（BMMS），该套件以政策语料库作为输入，返回针对任何已发布政策及任何自然语言应答系统的合规性报告。合规性达成分数（CAS）衡量系统受约束义务的加权达成程度，合规性鲁棒性边际（CRM）衡量在分级对抗压力下存活的达成比例；行为不变性（BIV）和行为倾向指数（BDI）随套件一同发布。维度仅通过通过一项已发布的准入测试来引入，其约束标准为归因：当裁判者改变时，该量值会变化，而目标保持固定，此时正在测量工具。应用该测试排除了套件自身报告的一个量值。在来自五个注册表的十一份文件中的1003项义务中，准入标准对供应商规格的盲法人类判断具有94.4%的精确度，对分析指南为50.0%，提取保真度为94.6%，在来自另外两家提供者的裁判者重新评分下，目标排序保持不变，而单个目标的绝对分数跨度高达0.22。我们将其应用于两个最详细的已发布行为规范。在扣除文件难度后，自身规范优势并未从零解决，但绝对自我合规则另当别论：GPT-4o在OpenAI发布的模型规范中，未能通过70.7%的硬约束，而Claude的两个模型分别未能通过0.0%和9.1%的硬约束。

articles.title: PathXAI: Evidence-guided structured pathology reporting by transferable tissue segmentation
articles.abstract: Pathology reporting requires translating tissue observations across regions and slides into specific diagnoses and supporting morphological descriptions. However, the use of explicit tissue-composition measurements to guide H&E-based report generation remains underexplored. Thus, we developed PathXAI, which combines segmentation-derived tissue information with H&E images and optional domain knowledge to guide diagnostic reasoning, targeted reinspection and structured report writing. Its segmentation component exceeded baselines in mean Dice on internal and external tests. In automated report evaluation on 1,200 public and 151 private cases, PathXAI achieved higher agreement with reference diagnoses and documented morphology than the H&E-based comparators. On the public evaluation cohort, PathXAI-Report exceeded Qwen + H&E in cancer family match rate by 4.4 percentage points and in finding F1 by 5.7 percentage points. PathXAI generates evidence-linked reports with a self-hosted pretrained vision-language model, without updating its weights.

articles.titleCn: PathXAI：基于可迁移组织分割的证据引导结构化病理报告
articles.abstractCn: 病理报告要求将组织观察结果从不同区域和切片中翻译成具体的诊断和形态学描述。然而，使用明确的组织成分测量来指导基于HE染色报告生成的方法仍处于探索阶段。因此，我们开发了PathXAI，该系统结合了分割得到的组织信息、HE图像以及可选的领域知识来指导诊断推理、目标重检和结构化报告撰写。其分割组件在内测和外测中的平均Dice系数均优于基线模型。在对1200个公开案例和151个私有案例进行自动报告评估时，PathXAI在参考诊断和记录形态学方面与HE染色对比方法相比表现出更高的符合度。在公开评估队列中，PathXAI-Report在癌症家族匹配率上比Qwen + HE高出4.4个百分点，在F1分数上高出5.7个百分点。PathXAI通过自托管的预训练视觉语言模型生成证据关联报告，且无需更新其权重。

articles.title: PhoPunct: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Transformer Architectures for Vietnamese Punctuation Restoration
articles.abstract: Vietnamese punctuation restoration is often evaluated on relatively small benchmarks, limiting conclusions about how architectural choices scale with data volume. We present a controlled benchmark on News and Novels corpora containing 22.1 million labeled tokens (19.9M News and 2.2M Novels). We evaluate 17 architectures formed from four pretrained Transformer backbones and optional bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) and conditional random field (CRF) layers, together with a PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF model, PhoPunct. Every model is trained for eight epochs with the same learning rate and without architecture-specific tuning. Under this fixed budget, adding Bi-LSTM and CRF layers does not reliably improve macro F1: in seven of eight matched domain-backbone comparisons, a plain Transformer classifier matches or outperforms its Bi-LSTM-CRF counterpart. PhoPunct obtains the best News result (61.35), whereas XLM-R with a CRF obtains the best Novels result (50.18), exceeding PhoPunct (48.97). These results show that the value of recurrent and structured-prediction heads depends on their optimization regime and motivate explicit separation between architectural improvements and improvements due to architecture-specific tuning. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/aisia-research-lab/PhoPunct

articles.titleCn: PhoPunct：越南标点符号恢复任务中Transformer架构的大规模基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 越南标点符号恢复任务通常在相对较小的基准上进行评估，这限制了关于架构选择如何随数据量扩展的结论。我们提出一个受控基准，包含News和Novels语料库，共含有2210万标记的token（1990万来自News，220万来自Novels）。我们评估了由四个预训练的Transformer主干网络和可选的双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）和条件随机场（CRF）层组成的17种架构，以及PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF模型PhoPunct。每个模型都使用相同的初始学习率进行八轮训练，且不进行特定于架构的微调。在这个固定的预算下，添加Bi-LSTM和CRF层并不能可靠地提高宏观F1值：在八次匹配领域-主干网络比较中的七次，纯Transformer分类器都达到了或超过了其Bi-LSTM-CRF对应模型的性能。PhoPunct获得了最佳的News结果（61.35），而带有CRF的XLM-R则获得了最佳的Novels结果（50.18），超过了PhoPunct（48.97）。这些结果表明，循环和结构化预测头的价值取决于它们的优化机制，并促使我们在架构改进和特定于架构的微调改进之间进行明确区分。我们的源代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/aisia-research-lab/PhoPunct

articles.title: AlienBench: A Benchmark of Structural Novelty in Language Model Outputs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for creative tasks such as writing, design, and idea generation. For these uses, it matters whether a model's ideas depart from familiar examples or stay close to them. Novelty is one standard measure of creativity, and current creativity evaluations ask human experts or LLM judges to rate how novel an output is. However, these ratings have no fixed reference for what counts as novel (or, in other terms, departure from the familiar). Measuring this departure requires a task with known familiar defaults. The structured imagination task from cognitive psychology is such a task. In this creativity test, people imagine a creature from another planet. The departure from features of Earth animals, such as bilateral symmetry and legs as mode of locomotion, is used as measure of creativity. We introduce AlienBench, a benchmark that adapts the structured imagination task to language models. Models describe alien creatures, and a panel of three LLM judges extracts ten biological features from the description and labels them as either Earth-typical or a departure. The sum of feature departures is the score of a description, from 0 to 10. Each model describes alien creatures under six prompt conditions that vary the framing of the task and the planetary environment. Each model generates 30 descriptions per condition (180 in total), and its overall score is the mean across these descriptions. We evaluate 10 language models, from frontier to open-weight models. Overall scores range from 3.28 (GPT-6 Luna) to 6.55 (Ministral 3 14B). Interestingly, open-weight models score higher than proprietary models in this task (5.40 vs. 4.58). Under the baseline prompt, the models depart from Earth defaults more often on average than 100 human participants on every feature. We release all prompts, generations, judge outputs, and scores.
