articles.titleCn: AlienBench：一种衡量语言模型输出结构新颖性的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于写作、设计和创意生成等任务。在这些应用中，模型想法是否偏离常见示例或保持接近至关重要。新颖性是衡量创造性的一个标准指标，当前的创造性评估要求人类专家或LLM评委对输出的新颖程度进行评分。然而，这些评分没有固定的参考标准来判断什么才算新颖（或者换句话说，与常见的偏离程度）。衡量这种偏离需要一个具有已知常见默认值的任务。认知心理学中的结构化想象任务就是这样一项任务。在这个创造性测试中，人们想象来自其他星球生物。与地球动物特征（如两侧对称和腿作为运动方式）的偏离程度被用作衡量创造性的指标。我们介绍了AlienBench，这是一个将结构化想象任务应用于语言模型的基准。模型描述外星生物，由三个LLM评委从描述中提取十个生物学特征，并将它们标记为地球典型或偏离。特征偏离的总和是描述的分数，范围从0到10。每个模型在六种提示条件下描述外星生物，这些条件变化了任务的框架和行星环境。每个模型在每个条件下生成30个描述（总共180个），其总分是这些描述的平均值。我们评估了10个语言模型，从前沿模型到开放权重模型。总分范围从3.28（GPT-6 Luna）到6.55（Ministral 3 14B）。有趣的是，在这个任务中，开放权重模型的得分高于专有模型（5.40 vs. 4.58）。在基准提示下，模型在所有特征上的平均偏离程度高于100名人类参与者的平均偏离程度。我们发布了所有提示、生成内容、评委输出和分数。

articles.title: MARS: Training Multilingual Search Agents for Retriever-Free Evidence Acquisition
articles.abstract: Existing multilingual retrieval-augmented generation relies heavily on learned retrievers and similarity-based ranking from multilingual collections, which are vulnerable to cross-lingual retrieval errors and indexing overhead. In this paper, we explore retriever-free multilingual search, where the model directly interacts with raw corpora through executable shell commands. This paradigm shifts the bottleneck to multilingual search action generation, where exact search is sensitive to entity surface forms and outcome-only supervision provides limited guidance for multi-turn search. To address these challenges, we propose MARS, a multilingual search agent in direct corpus interaction (DCI) with reinforcement learning (RL). MARS introduces corpus-native entity grounding to recover reliable lexical anchors from corpus evidence, mitigating failure to retrieve evidence. Meanwhile, we present a redundancy-aware search reward to encourage concise and effective search trajectories, addressing training collapse in RL of multilingual scenarios. Experiments show that \ours~consistently outperforms strong retrieval-based and DCI baselines, while demonstrating robust cross-lingual generalization and substantially reducing redundant corpus interactions.
articles.titleCn: MARS：用于无检索器证据获取的多语言搜索代理训练
articles.abstractCn: 现有的多语言检索增强生成严重依赖学习型检索器和多语言集合的基于相似度的排序，这些方法容易受到跨语言检索错误和索引开销的影响。在本文中，我们探索了无需检索器的多语言搜索，其中模型通过可执行的shell命令直接与原始语料库交互。这种范式将瓶颈转移到了多语言搜索动作生成，其中精确搜索对实体表面形式敏感，而仅提供结果监督对多轮搜索的指导有限。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MARS，一个在直接语料库交互（DCI）框架下使用强化学习（RL）的多语言搜索代理。MARS引入了语料库原生实体 grounding 来从语料库证据中恢复可靠的词汇锚点，从而缓解无法检索证据的问题。同时，我们提出了一个冗余感知搜索奖励机制，以鼓励简洁有效的搜索轨迹，解决多语言场景中强化学习训练崩溃的问题。实验表明，我们的方法始终优于强大的基于检索器和DCI基线，同时展现出稳健的跨语言泛化能力，并显著减少了冗余的语料库交互。

articles.title: The Invisible Gap: Romanized Indic Generation Fails Where Automatic Metrics Succeed
articles.abstract: Hundreds of millions of Indians communicate with digital systems in romanized Latin characters -- typing "aap kaise hain" rather than native script -- yet romanized Indic generation is absent from NLP benchmarks and evaluation frameworks. We demonstrate that automatic metrics (BGE-M3, BERTScore) systematically misrepresent the quality of romanized Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada generation. We evaluate four LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, Gemini 2.5-flash, Qwen3.5-35B) on 142 OpenAssistant query-response pairs. On a 72-response diagnostic subset, native speakers rate GPT-5.5 1.43 points higher than Claude Opus 4.8 on a 12-point rubric, whereas their full-dataset BGE-M3 means differ by only 0.004. Two distinct model-specific failure modes emerge: Gemini produces script spillage (16.9% of Telugu responses leak native script), while Qwen collapses to English-only output (16.2% of Kannada responses). We introduce a failure-aware evaluation policy that assigns zero to empty outputs, script-corrupted responses, and instruction collapses -- revealing failures metrics alone cannot detect. Our results show that evaluating romanized Indic generation requires a coordinated bundle: semantic similarity, script compliance, failure coverage, and native-speaker acceptability.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. All authors contributed equally
articles.titleCn: 《隐形差距：罗马化印度语生成在自动指标成功之处失败》
articles.abstractCn: 数亿印度人与数字化系统通过罗马化拉丁字符进行交流——他们输入“aap kaise hain”而非本土文字——然而罗马化印度语生成却未被纳入NLP基准和评估框架。我们证明自动指标（BGE-M3、BERTScore）系统性地歪曲了罗马化印地语、泰卢固语和卡纳达语生成的质量。我们评估了四款大型语言模型（Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini 2.5-flash、Qwen3.5-35B）在142组OpenAssistant问答对上的表现。在72组诊断子集上，母语者用12分制评分时认为GPT-5.5比Claude Opus 4.8高1.43分，但两者在完整数据集上的BGE-M3均值差异仅为0.004。出现了两种截然不同的模型特定失效模式：Gemini产生文字溢出（16.9%的泰卢固语回答泄露本土文字），而Qwen完全输出英文（16.2%的卡纳达语回答）。我们引入了一种失效感知评估策略，对空输出、文字损坏回答和指令坍缩赋零分——揭示仅靠失效指标无法检测的问题。我们的结果表明，评估罗马化印度语生成需要协调组合：语义相似度、文字合规性、失效覆盖率和母语者接受度。

articles.title: Large Language Model Deployment on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices: A Practitioners Survey
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed many areas of artificial intelligence (AI), but their substantial resource requirements limit their deployment on mobile and edge devices. Although LLMs have demonstrated impressive capabilities in various applications, the next challenge is deploying these models on resource-limited edge devices. Recent innovations in software optimizations and specialized hardware have made it feasible to deploy LLMs on edge devices. Edge deployment offers benefits including local data processing, cost savings, reduced latency, and personalized responses. This paper reviews the latest techniques that make the deployment of LLMs on edge devices feasible.
articles.titleCn: 资源受限边缘设备上的大型语言模型部署：从业者调查
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已经改变了人工智能（AI）的许多领域，但它们巨大的资源需求限制了它们在移动设备和边缘设备上的部署。尽管LLMs在各种应用中展示了令人印象深刻的能力，但下一个挑战是将这些模型部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。软件优化和专用硬件的最新创新使得在边缘设备上部署LLMs成为可能。边缘部署提供了包括本地数据处理、成本节约、降低延迟和个性化响应等优势。本文回顾了使LLMs在边缘设备上部署成为可能的最新技术。

articles.title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models?
articles.abstract: Benchmark gains from reasoning-enhanced large language models encourage the assumption that these models should broadly perform better on complex generative tasks, but this remains underexplored in open-ended, creative domains shaped by nuances of reader experience. We tested this assumption through the lens of psychological depth in short stories. We compared DeepSeek-R1 vs. DeepSeek-V3, our closest available contrast for reasoning-oriented post-training, and GPT-5 vs. GPT-4o, through 60 blinded pairwise evaluations in which seven human annotators and an ensemble LLM-as-a-Judge rated prompt-matched story outputs. Human evaluations showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was slightly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0-62.9% across two reasoning-effort settings), whereas DeepSeek-R1 fell behind DeepSeek-V3 (42.9%). Although this pattern was marked by low inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's $α= 0.070$), our annotation-quality checks suggested genuine evaluative subjectivity, plausibly reflecting distinct annotator decision schemes rather than annotation failure. In contrast, the LLM-as-a-Judge showed a strong pro-reasoning bias (98.3% of pairs vs. 55.2% of human votes), consistent across its five configurations and partly tracking sentence length. These findings suggest that, at the frontier, reasoning-related quality differences are small enough to be dominated by reader subjectivity, and that LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators can obscure this subjectivity in nuanced creative-generation tasks.
articles.titleCn: 推理是否提升了大型语言模型的心理深度？
articles.abstractCn: 基准测试中推理增强型大型语言模型的收益鼓励人们假设这些模型在复杂的生成任务上应表现出更广泛的优越性，但这在由读者体验细微差别塑造的开放式、创造性领域仍缺乏探索。我们通过短篇小说的心理深度视角来检验这一假设。我们比较了DeepSeek-R1与DeepSeek-V3（我们目前最接近的推理导向后训练对比模型）以及GPT-5与GPT-4o，通过60次盲法配对评估，其中七位人类标注者和集成式LLM裁判对提示匹配的故事输出进行了评分。人类评估显示没有普遍的推理优势：GPT-5略微优于GPT-4o（在两种推理努力设置下分别为60.0-62.9%），而DeepSeek-R1落后于DeepSeek-V3（42.9%）。尽管这种模式显示出低标注者间一致性（Krippendorff's α=0.070），但我们的标注质量检查表明存在真实的评价主观性，可能反映了不同标注者的决策方案而非标注失败。相比之下，LLM裁判表现出强烈的推理倾向（98.3%的配对与55.2%的人类投票一致），这种倾向在其五种配置中保持一致，并部分与句子长度相关。这些发现表明，在前沿领域，与推理相关的质量差异足够小，以至于会被读者主观性主导，并且LLM裁判在细微的创造性生成任务中可能掩盖这种主观性。

articles.title: Real-Time Short-Response Selection for Spoken Dialogue Systems
articles.abstract: To realize spoken dialogue systems that can interact naturally with users, it is important for the system to respond to user utterances at appropriate timings. To achieve such natural turn-taking, the system needs not only to predict appropriate response timings but also to mask delays caused by language generation and speech synthesis so that they are not perceived by the user. We propose a real-time short-response selection task that can be integrated with existing turn-taking models to mask generation delay. To address this task, the proposed model learns the mapping between dialogue context and short responses using contrastive learning. When a turn-taking event is detected, the system selects a response from a set of pre-generated candidates. The selected response is played while the main response is being generated. Experimental results show that the proposed method learns to select short responses based on dialogue context, outperforming random and LLM-based baselines. Moreover, integrating response selection maintained turn-taking prediction performance and added minimal processing overhead.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables
articles.titleCn: 实时短响应选择技术应用于对话系统
articles.abstractCn: 为了实现能够与用户自然交互的对话系统，系统需要在恰当的时机响应用户的语句。为了实现这种自然的交替发言，系统不仅需要预测合适的响应时机，还需要掩盖语言生成和语音合成造成的延迟，以确保用户无法感知。我们提出了一种实时短响应选择任务，可以与现有的交替发言模型集成以掩盖生成延迟。为了解决这个问题，所提出的模型使用对比学习来学习对话上下文与短响应之间的映射。当检测到交替发言事件时，系统从一组预生成的候选中选择一个响应。在主响应生成的同时播放所选的响应。实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够根据对话上下文选择短响应，优于随机和基于LLM的基线模型。此外，集成响应选择保持了交替发言预测性能，并增加了最小的处理开销。

articles.title: Failure Profiling and Reachable Trajectory Selection for Reasoning Distillation
articles.abstract: Training smaller language models on reasoning solutions generated by a larger teacher model is the prevailing approach for transferring mathematical reasoning capabilities. However, the student tends to overfit the output distribution of the teacher and generalizes poorly when its own behavior at inference time deviates from the training data. Recent methods attempt to bridge this gap by incorporating error data, yet the corrective trajectories still reflect the reasoning patterns of the teacher, which the student cannot reliably reproduce, leaving the distribution mismatch largely unresolved. We propose a method, Failure Profiling and Reachable Trajectory Selection (FPRT), built on the insight that effective training data should be jointly determined by what the student fails on and what it can realistically learn. Our method first profiles the failure behavior of the student on each problem through repeated sampling, characterizing it in terms of error rate and error consistency to reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes. Each mode demands a fundamentally different training signal. The diagnosed mode then guides candidate generation from the teacher via distinct prompting strategies tailored to each failure type. Among the correct candidates, our method selects the one whose initial reasoning steps after the point of divergence are most reproducible by the student. These first corrective steps constitute the primary bottleneck, while the remaining steps follow an already corrected context and can therefore be continued more readily. This contrasts with standard reranking approaches, which score the trajectory as a whole and thereby dilute the signal at the critical reasoning transition. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves the SOTA performance across the five benchmarks on both student backbones.

articles.titleCn: 推理蒸馏中的失效分析与可达轨迹选择
articles.abstractCn: 在大型教师模型生成的推理解决方案上训练更小的语言模型是迁移数学推理能力的常用方法。然而，学生倾向于过度拟合教师模型的输出分布，当其推理时的行为偏离训练数据时泛化能力较差。最近的方法尝试通过引入错误数据来弥补这一差距，但修正轨迹仍然反映教师模型的推理模式，学生无法可靠地复制这些模式，导致分布不匹配问题未能得到有效解决。我们提出了一种名为“故障分析及可达轨迹选择”（FPRT）的方法，该方法基于一个见解：有效的训练数据应由学生失败的地方以及其能够实际学习的部分共同决定。我们的方法首先通过重复采样分析学生在每个问题上的故障行为，从错误率和错误一致性等方面对其进行表征，以揭示不同质的故障模式。每种模式都需要一种根本不同的训练信号。诊断出的模式会通过针对每种故障类型量身定制的不同提示策略，从教师模型中生成候选轨迹。在正确的候选轨迹中，我们的方法选择在分歧点之后学生最容易复制的初始推理步骤的那个轨迹。这些最初的修正步骤构成了主要瓶颈，而其余步骤则在一个已经修正的上下文中继续，因此更容易继续进行。这与标准的重新排序方法形成对比，后者将整个轨迹作为整体进行评分，从而稀释了关键推理转换点的信号。实验表明，我们的方法在五个基准测试上均实现了学生主干网络的最佳性能。

articles.title: Language, Not Code Abstraction: Natural-language Training Shapes Brain-aligned Geometry
articles.abstract: Code-trained language models produce positive brain scores, which raises the question of whether abstract structure learned from programming languages can substitute for natural-language training. We trained 25 GPT-2-small models on TinyStories, Python, C functions, x86-64 assembly, and the corresponding machine code, and scored them using a shared tokenizer and encoding procedure against matched random-weight models. On Pereira-243 and Tuckute2024, TinyStories exceeds the mean of the four code models by $Δr = 0.053$ and $0.059$ (Holm-corrected $p<0.001$), while code training leaves alignment near the random-weight level. The language advantage is benchmark-specific: Blank2014 shows no corrected language-code difference, and Fedorenko2016 shows no language benefit. Geometry tracks the encoding result on Pereira-243: TinyStories seeds converge on the most similar representations, and its fit-free correspondence with neural dissimilarity peaks at $ρ= 0.14$, twice the code and random-weight levels. Binary-trained models have about three effective dimensions, so seed agreement alone does not imply neural correspondence. Updating only the embedding matrix on English improves mean-over-depth alignment for every code model more than an equal update on its own corpus. Within this architecture and training setup, natural-language training produces a distinct representational geometry with closer neural correspondence on Pereira-243

articles.titleCn: 语言而非代码抽象：自然语言训练塑造与大脑对齐的几何结构
articles.abstractCn: 经过代码训练的语言模型产生了正面的脑部评分，这引发了关于从编程语言中学习到的抽象结构是否可以替代自然语言训练的问题。我们用TinyStories、Python、C函数、x86-64汇编以及相应的机器代码训练了25个GPT-2-small模型，并使用共享的标记器和编码程序对它们与匹配的随机权重模型进行评分。在Pereira-243和Tuckute2024上，TinyStories的得分超过了四个代码模型的平均值$Δr = 0.053$和$0.059$（Holm校正$p<0.001$），而代码训练使对齐保持在随机权重水平附近。语言优势是基准特定的：Blank2014显示没有校正的语言-代码差异，Fedorenko2016显示没有语言优势。几何学追踪了Pereira-243上的编码结果：TinyStories的种子在相似度最高的表示上收敛，并且其与神经差异峰值的无拟合对应关系在$ρ= 0.14$时达到代码和随机权重水平的两倍。二进制训练的模型大约有三个有效维度，因此种子的一致性并不一定意味着神经对应关系。仅更新英语的嵌入矩阵可以提高每个代码模型在深度上的平均对齐度，超过对其自身语料库的同等更新。在这个架构和训练设置中，自然语言训练产生了一种独特的表示几何，在Pereira-243上具有更紧密的神经对应关系。

articles.title: Seeing vs. Counting: Complexity Twins Show Where Multimodal LLMs Fail on Diagrams
articles.abstract: When a multimodal LLM miscounts in a diagram, does it fail at seeing or at counting? Existing visual graph and puzzle benchmarks vary visual density and algorithmic hardness together, confounding the two. We pair counting questions about the same drawing that sit in different counting-complexity classes, such as its spanning trees (a determinant) and its simple paths (#P-complete), and use a transcription probe and a text-only control to separate reading from computing. We test Gemini, Gemma and Qwen3-VL models; for the Gemini models, the answer depends on how the model computes. In chain of thought, most of them read small drawings correctly and then fail at counting, at a rate set far more by the size of the answer than by its complexity class (for the primary model, the odds of an exact answer fall 2.38-fold per decade of the answer). Given code and an exact transcription, the primary model counts correctly even on 10x10 grids, and reading becomes the bottleneck: a single view misses horizontal edges, and a second reading of a rotated copy with crop checks reads 86/96 large grids exactly, against 57/96 when the upright reading is simply repeated.

articles.titleCn: 看见与计数：复杂双胞胎揭示多模态LLM在图表上的失败之处
articles.abstractCn: 当多模态大语言模型在图表中计数错误时，是看错了还是数错了？现有的视觉图和谜题基准同时变化视觉密度和算法难度，将两者混淆。我们将处于不同计数复杂度类别的同一绘图计数问题配对，例如其生成树（确定性问题）和其简单路径（#P完全问题），并使用转录探针和纯文本控制来区分理解和计算。我们测试了Gemini、Gemma和Qwen3-VL模型；对于Gemini模型，答案取决于模型的计算方式。在思维链中，它们大多数能正确读取小绘图，但在计数时失败，其失败率更多地由答案大小而非其复杂度类别决定（对于主要模型，精确答案的概率每增加一个数量级下降2.38倍）。给定代码和精确转录，主要模型即使在10x10网格上也能正确计数，此时读取成为瓶颈：单次视图会遗漏水平边，而第二次读取旋转副本并检查裁剪后，能精确读取86/96个大网格，相比之下，直立读取简单重复时只能精确读取57/96。

articles.title: Same Facts, Different Remedy: Linguistic Profiling and Arbitrariness in LLM and System One Decisions
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to resolve consumer complaints, and the way complainants write varies with age, education and socioeconomic status (SES). We audit three remedy-decision systems using sociolinguistic rewrites of US consumer financial complaints that are instructed to preserve every fact: two generative LLMs that return a single label (GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-mini) and a probabilistic "System One" model that returns a distribution over remedies (Jev). Using pre-registered hypotheses tested once on held-out complaints, we separate two phenomena that single-label audits conflate. At the group scale, older, college-educated and higher-SES styles receive slightly more generous remedies; these effects replicate but are small, with every monetary-remedy gap within 0.5 percentage points. At the individual scale, two style versions of the same complaint receive different monetary decisions 2.6-6.3% of the time. In a variance-component analysis of the probabilistic model, persona components shared across the two rewrite models account for about 1.6% of within-complaint variation. The persona gaps are associated mainly with delivery (vocabulary, grammar, politeness) rather than content. Positive controls show that all three systems respond 49-387 times more strongly to remedy-relevant facts than to style. Rewriting every complaint into one standard style reduced GPT-4o-mini's education and SES gaps by 94% and 87% while retaining fact sensitivity, but reversed two of the probabilistic model's gaps and did not make individual decisions more stable. Independent LLM auditors flagged material fact changes in 3.3% and 11.7% of rewrites, and instability persisted among unflagged rewrites. Fairness audits of LLM decision systems should report group disparities and individual instability as separate outcomes.
articles.comment: 29 pages, 7 figures. Code, prompts and pre-registrations: https://github.com/colinpriest/llm-jev-linguistic-profiling
articles.titleCn: 相同事实，不同对策：大型语言模型和系统一决策中的语言分析和任意性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于解决消费者投诉，而投诉者的写作方式因年龄、教育程度和社会经济地位（SES）而异。我们对三个补救决策系统进行了审计，使用经过社会语言学改写的美国消费者金融投诉文本，并要求保留所有事实：两个生成式大型语言模型（GPT-4o-mini和GPT-5-mini）返回单一标签，以及一个概率性“系统一”模型（Jev）返回补救措施的分布。通过预先注册的假设，在保留的投诉上仅进行一次测试，我们区分了单一标签审计所混淆的两个现象。在群体层面，年长、受过大学教育和高社会经济地位的写作风格获得的补救措施略为慷慨；这些效应得到了验证，但影响很小，所有货币补救措施的差距都在0.5个百分点以内。在个体层面，同一投诉的两个风格版本在2.6-6.3%的情况下获得不同的货币决策。在概率模型的方差分量分析中，两个改写模型共享的角色分量约占投诉内变异的1.6%。角色差距主要与表达方式（词汇、语法、礼貌）而非内容相关。阳性对照实验表明，所有三个系统对补救措施相关事实的反应强度比风格高出49-387倍。将所有投诉改写为单一标准风格减少了GPT-4o-mini的教育和社会经济地位差距的94%和87%，同时保留了事实敏感性，但逆转了概率模型的两个差距，并未使个体决策更稳定。独立的LLM审计者在3.3%和11.7%的改写中标记了实质性事实变化，未标记的改写中不稳定性仍然存在。LLM决策系统的公平性审计应将群体差异和个体不稳定性作为单独结果报告。

articles.title: Beyond Truncation? Entailment-Licensed Elision and the Limits of Semantic Preservation in LLM Decoding
articles.abstract: Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) answer at greater length than a request needs. We ask whether a training-free controller inside the decoding loop can remove that surplus while preserving content, judged against the simplest possible baseline: truncating the model's own answer to the same length. An entropy-gated logits processor removes 25.5-34.9% of tokens on MT-Bench development questions and 19.9-34.2% on a sealed test split within pre-registered BERTScore non-inferiority margins, yet we prove and confirm by audit that its output is always a prefix of the unmodified answer: the saving is truncation. A survey of 23 training-free mechanism families finds none that selects content better than truncation without oracle labels. We therefore introduce Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision (ELIDE), which, at each sentence boundary, withholds a span from the reader only when a natural-language inference model judges it entailed by the text already shown, while leaving the model's generation unchanged. ELIDE beats matched-length truncation on three model families, but reading 936 of its elisions on 670 public prompts shows that 59% harm the answer, a failure that no automatic measure detects. Scoping the licence to its discourse unit reduces the harmful share to about one elision in ten on two fresh tests.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
articles.titleCn: 超越截断？基于推论许可的省略与LLM解码中语义保留的局限性
articles.abstractCn: 指令微调的大型语言模型（LLMs）的回答往往比请求所需的更长。我们探究了在解码循环中嵌入的无训练控制器能否在不损失内容的情况下移除这种冗余，其基准是最简单的可能方法：将模型自身的回答截断至相同长度。熵门控的logits处理器在MT-Bench开发问题集上移除了25.5-34.9%的token，在预注册BERTScore非劣性边界的密封测试集上移除了19.9-34.2%的token，但我们证明并通过审计确认其输出始终是未修改回答的前缀：节省是通过截断实现的。对23种无训练机制家族的调查发现，没有一种在无神谕标签的情况下比截断选择内容更好。因此，我们引入了蕴含许可解码内省除法（ELIDE），该机制在每个句子边界处，仅当自然语言推理模型判断该片段由已展示的文本蕴含时，才向读者保留该片段，同时保持模型的生成不变。ELIDE在三种模型家族上优于等长截断，但在670个公共提示上读取其936个省略片段显示，59%的省略损害了回答，这一失误没有任何自动度量能检测到。将许可范围限定于其语篇单元将有害比例减少到大约十个中有一次。

articles.title: Phantom Consensus: Measuring Social Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making
articles.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly aggregate judgments across model instances, but reasoning about other agents can itself introduce failure. We study a setting in which LLMs shift their public decisions after observing ambiguous social signals while reporting inaccurate estimates of what other agents privately judged, even when the group's recorded private judgments do not support the apparent consensus. We call this failure phantom consensus and study it as a pluralistic-ignorance-style pattern in controlled LLM collectives. To measure this phenomenon, we introduce PHANTOM-Bench, a benchmark that separates isolated private judgments, public decisions after ambiguous social signals, elicited estimates of the group's private judgment, transparency-based recovery, and controls for neutral public text and explicit vote-following. Across nine closed- and open-weight models, ambiguous public signals consistently degrade decision quality and can turn correct private group judgments into incorrect public collective outcomes. Public accuracy drops by as much as 47.8 percentage points, and collective rationality failures reach 47.3% in the most susceptible setting. We observe substantial errors in reported group-private beliefs alongside public-stage failures, while control conditions reveal model-dependent differences in susceptibility to ambiguous and explicit peer signals. Revealing the agents' recorded private decisions repairs many failures without revealing the gold label, although recovery varies across models. Our results show that evaluating multi-agent LLM systems requires measuring not only final agreement, but whether that agreement reflects independently measured private judgments or an apparent consensus.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, SocialAgent Workshop
articles.titleCn: 幻影共识：测量多智能体LLM决策中的社会推理
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体LLM系统越来越多地整合不同模型实例的判断，但推理其他智能体的行为本身也可能导致错误。我们研究了一种场景：LLM在观察到模糊的社会信号后会改变其公开决策，同时报告对其他智能体私密判断的不准确估计，即使群体的记录私密判断并不支持明显的共识。我们将这种错误称为幽灵共识，并将其作为一种多元无知式模式在受控的LLM集体中进行研究。为了衡量这一现象，我们引入了PHANTOM-Bench基准，该基准将孤立的私密判断、模糊社会信号后的公开决策、群体私密判断的诱导估计、基于透明度的恢复以及中性公开文本和明确投票跟随进行分离和控制。在九种封闭权重和开放权重模型中，模糊的公共信号始终降低决策质量，并可能将正确的私密群体判断转变为错误的公共集体结果。公共准确率下降高达47.8个百分点，集体理性失败率在最易受影响的场景中达到47.3%。我们观察到在公共阶段失败的同时，报告的群体私密信念存在大量错误，而控制条件揭示了模型在不同易感性方面的差异，即对模糊和明确同伴信号的反应。揭示智能体的记录私密决策可以修复许多错误，尽管恢复程度因模型而异。我们的结果表明，评估多智能体LLM系统不仅需要衡量最终的一致性，还需要判断这种一致性是否反映了独立测量的私密判断或明显的共识。

articles.title: Using an LLM to Tackle Difficult Cases in NER for Nepali Tweets
articles.abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is challenging for social media data in a low-resource language. LLMs often lag behind pretrained language models (PLMs) in NER performance, but they show promise in handling cases that PLMs struggle with. Using a dataset of Nepali tweets, we split the test set into "easy" and "hard" cases using token probabilities from a fine-tuned pretrained language model (PLM). We then evaluate an LLM on the hard test cases using 16 different prompt configurations. We find that selecting examples based on semantic similarity and increasing the number of examples improves F1 score by almost 10 points from the baseline configuration. Although the LLM underperforms the PLM on the full and easy test sets, it surpasses the PLM on the hard test set, resulting in an improved score when the two models are combined.
articles.titleCn: 使用大型语言模型解决尼泊尔推文命名实体识别中的难题
articles.abstractCn: 命名实体识别（NER）在低资源语言的社交媒体数据中具有挑战性。大型语言模型（LLMs）在NER性能上通常落后于预训练语言模型（PLMs），但在处理PLMs难以应对的情况方面显示出潜力。我们使用尼泊尔推文数据集，利用微调的预训练语言模型（PLM）生成的标记概率将测试集分为“简单”和“困难”两类。然后，我们使用16种不同的提示配置在困难测试集上评估LLM。我们发现，根据语义相似性选择示例并增加示例数量可将F1分数从基线配置提高近10个百分点。尽管LLM在全量和简单测试集上的表现不如PLM，但在困难测试集上它超越了PLM，当两种模型结合使用时，得分得到提升。

articles.title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training
articles.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is the most reliable way to obtain accurate low-bit large language models (LLMs), but training with AdamW keeps two dense FP32 states for every weight matrix. We find that low-rank memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore and LDAdam degrade substantially in QAT. A considerable part of the QAT momentum lies outside its top-r singular subspace, and projection-based methods discard this part at every step. We further observe that this residual remains useful when only its sign is kept. Based on these observations, we propose ResQAdam. It keeps a single BF16 momentum, applies Adam only to the r x r coordinates of the principal subspace, and adds a normalized sign update computed from the residual. We evaluate ResQAdam with two from-scratch QAT methods and three QAT fine-tuning pipelines, with weights quantized down to 2 bits. It reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to AdamW, stays close to AdamW in most settings, and lowers training throughput by less than 2%.
articles.titleCn: ResQAdam：保留残差的适应性优化算法，用于内存高效的量化感知训练
articles.abstractCn: 量化感知训练（QAT）是获得精确低比特大型语言模型（LLM）最可靠的方法，但使用AdamW训练时，每个权重矩阵会保留两个密集FP32状态。我们发现，如GaLore和LDAdam等低秩内存高效优化器在QAT中的性能会显著下降。QAT动量的相当一部分位于其顶部r个奇异子空间之外，而基于投影的方法在每个步骤中都会丢弃这部分。我们进一步观察到，当仅保留其符号时，这部分残差仍然有用。基于这些观察，我们提出了ResQAdam。它保留一个BF16动量，仅对主要子空间的r x r坐标应用Adam，并添加一个从残差计算出的归一化符号更新。我们使用两种从头开始的QAT方法和三种QAT微调流程评估了ResQAdam，权重量化至2比特。与AdamW相比，它将优化器状态内存减少了71%至74%，在大多数设置中接近AdamW，并将训练吞吐量降低了不到2%。

articles.title: On the Incompleteness of do-calculus for Universal Identifiability
articles.abstract: We study the problem of causal effect identification from an arbitrary set of observational and/or interventional distributions, which we call Universal Identifiability (uID). The uID problem generalizes existing classical identifiability (ID) and general identifiability (gID) problems, which considered the identification problem from either mere observational distributions or a specific type of interventional distributions. Prior research has established graphical criteria to determine when a causal effect is identifiable in ID and gID problems. Moreover, algorithms that leverage do-calculus and basic probability manipulations have been proposed to compute these effects. Consequently, it has been shown that do-calculus is both sound and complete in these problems. Despite these well-established results, a formal definition of what it means for the do-calculus to be complete does not exist. We propose a rigorous formalization for the completeness of the do-calculus and show that the completeness results in previous work remain valid. However, for more general problems, such as uID, the rules of do-calculus are no longer complete. This is perhaps the reason why the uID problem has remained open thus far.
articles.titleCn: 关于do演算在普遍可识别性上的不完备性
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究从任意一组观测分布和/或干预分布出发的因果效应识别问题，称之为通用可识别性（uID）。uID问题推广了现有的经典可识别性（ID）和一般可识别性（gID）问题，后者分别考虑了从纯粹的观测分布或特定类型的干预分布出发的识别问题。已有研究建立了图形标准，用于确定在ID和gID问题中何时因果效应是可识别的。此外，还提出了利用do-calculus和基本概率运算来计算这些效应的算法。因此，已经证明do-calculus在这些问题中既是可靠的也是完备的。尽管已有这些成熟的结果，但do-calculus完备性的正式定义尚不存在。我们提出了do-calculus完备性的严格形式化，并证明了先前工作的完备性结果仍然有效。然而，对于更一般的问题，例如uID，do-calculus的规则不再完备。这或许就是为什么uID问题至今仍悬而未决的原因。

articles.title: From Procedures to Permissions: Learning Precise Subagent Authorization from Agent Skills
articles.abstract: As language agents tackle increasingly complex tasks, they increasingly rely on multiple agents to coordinate specialized work, requiring decisions not only about what each subagent should do but also which tools and workspace resources it should access. Existing agent systems provide mechanisms for controlling tools and execution environments, but do not directly specify the resources required by each delegated subtask. Moreover, task outcomes and execution trajectories alone provide limited supervision for determining whether a subagent has received appropriate permissions. We observe that Agent Skills encode procedural knowledge describing the operations, tools, and files required at each step, providing a natural source of supervision for authorization. Building on this observation, we synthesize tasks and step-by-step procedures from Skills, execute them through subagent delegation in interactive environments, and use verified trajectories to construct training data for task execution and authorization. On ClawArena-Team, our method improves tool permission precision by 13.4 percentage points and workspace permission precision by 24.1 percentage points, while increasing overall task success by 11.6 percentage points for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. On Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SkillsBench, our method remains competitive with existing agent data synthesis approaches. These results show that the procedural knowledge embedded in Agent Skills provides a source of supervision for precise subagent orchestration that task outcomes alone cannot provide.
articles.titleCn: 从流程到权限：从代理技能中学习精确的子代理授权
articles.abstractCn: 随着语言代理处理日益复杂的任务，它们越来越依赖多个代理来协调专业工作，这需要决定每个子代理应该做什么，以及它应该访问哪些工具和工作空间资源。现有的代理系统提供了控制工具和执行环境的机制，但并未直接指定每个委托子任务所需的资源。此外，仅凭任务结果和执行轨迹对于确定子代理是否获得了适当的权限提供有限的监督。我们观察到，代理技能编码了描述每一步所需的操作、工具和文件的程序性知识，为授权提供了自然的监督来源。基于这一观察，我们从技能中综合任务和逐步程序，在交互环境中通过子代理委托执行，并使用验证过的轨迹来构建用于任务执行和授权的训练数据。在ClawArena-Team上，我们的方法将工具权限精度提高了13.4个百分点，工作空间权限精度提高了24.1个百分点，同时使Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的整体任务成功率提高了11.6个百分点。在Terminal-Bench 2.1和SkillsBench上，我们的方法与现有的代理数据合成方法保持竞争力。这些结果表明，嵌入在代理技能中的程序性知识为精确的子代理协调提供了监督来源，而任务结果本身无法提供。

articles.title: Richness Is Not Evenness: Ordered Renyi Crossings under Self-Training
articles.abstract: Recursive self-training of language models, a setting studied in model collapse, can reduce vocabulary while making frequent words, mostly function words, less dominant. We fine-tune English GPT-2 on its own output for nine generations, vary the training-data sampling temperature, and measure every model with one fixed sampler. As training temperature rises, Renyi entropy changes turn from loss to gain at distinct temperatures: min-entropy first, then collision entropy, Shannon entropy and observed richness. Between the outer crossings, word types fall while the most-common word becomes less dominant. Untruncated training at T = 1 lies in this interval: at 13,000 words, generation 9 has 24% fewer types than generation 0 yet collision entropy is 0.91 bits higher. The ordering persists with a finer grid, different measurement samplers, a fixed word budget and five fresh training seeds. Min-entropy again crosses before richness in four further settings (in Hindi only at interpolated roots) and in 12 of 13 distinct measurements under eight text representations. Next-token identities and a categorical simulation isolate decoding and sampling effects; the crossing order remains empirical. Fine-tuning on human text can produce the same split while likelihood improves, and no single order's sign reliably identifies worse likelihood across the tested settings. We recommend reporting entropy profiles at stated budgets with an independent quality measure.
articles.titleCn: 丰富性并非均匀性：自训练下的有序雷尼交叉
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的递归自训练，在模型坍塌研究中是一个被探讨的设置，它可以在减少词汇量的同时，使高频词（主要是功能词）不再占据主导地位。我们对英语GPT-2在其自身输出上进行九代微调，改变训练数据采样温度，并用一个固定的采样器对每个模型进行测量。随着训练温度的升高，Renyi熵的变化在特定的温度点从损失转变为增益：首先是最小熵，然后是碰撞熵、香农熵和观察到的丰富度。在两次外部分叉之间，词型数量减少，而最常见的词不再占据主导地位。在T=1的无截断训练中处于这个区间：在13,000个词的情况下，第九代的词型数量比零代减少了24%，但碰撞熵却高0.91比特。这种顺序在更细的网格、不同的测量采样器、固定的词预算和五个新的训练种子下依然存在。在四个进一步设置中（仅在插值根处为印地语）和13种不同测量中的12种情况下，最小熵再次在丰富度之前交叉。下一词身份和分类模拟可以分离解码和采样效应；交叉顺序仍然是经验性的。在人类文本上进行微调可以产生相同的分割，同时似然性得到提高，并且没有单一顺序的符号能够在测试设置中可靠地识别出更差的似然性。我们建议在声明的预算下报告熵曲线，并使用一个独立的质量度量。
